<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.0/css/all.min.css">
<!-- Golden Layout - the actual dockable/resizable/floatable panel engine behind
     the Contents / Map / Properties workspace, replacing the old fixed rail +
     fixed canvas split. Requires jQuery (v1.x's one hard dependency). -->
<script src="https://unpkg.com/jquery@3.7.1/dist/jquery.min.js"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/golden-layout@1.5.9/src/css/goldenlayout-base.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/golden-layout@1.5.9/src/css/goldenlayout-light-theme.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/golden-layout@1.5.9/dist/goldenlayout.min.js"></script>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" integrity="sha256-p4NxAoJBhIIN+hmNHrzRCf9tD/miZyoHS5obTRR9BMY=" crossorigin="">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js" integrity="sha256-20nQCchB9co0qIjJZRGuk2/Z9VM+kNiyxNV1lvTlZBo=" crossorigin=""></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet-draw@1.0.4/dist/leaflet.draw.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet-draw@1.0.4/dist/leaflet.draw.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/@turf/turf@6/turf.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/jszip@3.10.1/dist/jszip.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/shpjs@4.0.4/dist/shp.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/@tmcw/togeojson@5.8.1/dist/togeojson.umd.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/tokml@0.4.0/tokml.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/togpx@0.5.4/togpx.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet-image@0.4.0/leaflet-image.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet.heat@0.2.0/dist/leaflet-heat.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/jspdf@2.5.1/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#0a0a0a;--ink-2:#2a2a26;--ink-3:#3a3a34;--ink-4:#5a5a52;--ink-mute:#8a8780;
  --surface:#fafaf6;--surface-2:#ffffff;--hairline:rgba(10,10,10,.06);
  --shadow-card:0 1px 0 rgba(10,10,10,.04),0 8px 32px -16px rgba(10,10,10,.10);
  --shadow-float:0 4px 16px rgba(10,10,10,.08),0 16px 48px -12px rgba(10,10,10,.22);
  --signal:#228883;--signal-dark:#166b67;--signal-soft:rgba(34,136,131,.11);
  --blue:#185FA5;--blue-lt:#E6F1FB;--blue-dk:#0C447C;
  --purple:#534AB7;--purple-lt:#EEEDFE;
  --green:#3B6D11;--green-lt:#EAF3DE;--green-dk:#27500A;
  --amber:#854F0B;--amber-lt:#FAEEDA;--amber-dk:#633806;
  --radius:16px;--radius-sm:10px;
  --sans:'Poppins',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --rail-w:224px;
  --float-w:296px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;font-family:var(--sans);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink-3)}
.navbar,.navbar-primary,.web-footer,.page-header-wrapper,.page-breadcrumbs{display:none!important}
/* Break fully out of the website theme's Bootstrap-style wrapper — this
   page IS the app shell, full viewport, same escape hatch patrol-map uses. */
.container,.page-content-wrapper,.webpage-content,.page_content,.page-content{max-width:none!important;width:100%!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important}
#spatial-root{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100vh;height:100dvh;width:100vw}
/* The ribbon now spans full width at the very top (was previously nested
   inside .ss-main, alongside the rail); everything below it is Golden
   Layout's domain. */
#spatial-root .ss-ribbon{flex-shrink:0}
#spatial-root #glContainer{flex:1;min-height:0;position:relative}
/* Golden Layout gives each panel's content a wrapper it sizes itself -
   our moved-in content just needs to actually fill that wrapper. */
#spatial-root .lm_content{overflow:hidden}
#spatial-root .lm_content>.gl-fill{height:100%;width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
/* The rail's own width rule no longer applies once it's a GL panel (GL
   sizes the column instead) - only its internal flex-column/scroll
   behavior is still wanted. */
#spatial-root .lm_content .app-rail{width:100%;height:100%;border-right:none}
/* panelDetail used to be an absolutely-positioned float; as the always-on
   Properties panel it just needs to fill its GL container instead. */
#spatial-root .lm_content .props-panel{position:static;width:100%;height:100%;max-height:none;box-shadow:none;border-radius:0;border:none}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
button,input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit}

/* ═══ APP NAV RAIL ═══ */
#spatial-root .app-rail{width:var(--rail-w);flex-shrink:0;height:100%;background:var(--surface-2);border-right:1px solid var(--hairline);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow-y:auto}
#spatial-root .rail-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:16px 16px 14px}
#spatial-root .rail-brand-mark{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0}
#spatial-root .rail-brand-name{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#spatial-root .rail-nav{flex:1;padding:2px 10px 14px}
#spatial-root .rail-group{margin-top:16px}
#spatial-root .rail-group:first-child{margin-top:2px}
#spatial-root .rail-group-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--ink-mute);padding:0 8px 6px}
#spatial-root .rail-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-3);transition:background .15s}
#spatial-root .rail-link:hover{background:rgba(10,10,10,.05)}
#spatial-root .rail-link.active{background:var(--ink);color:#fafaf6;font-weight:600}
#spatial-root .rail-link i{width:15px;text-align:center;font-size:12.5px;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.85}
#spatial-root .rail-foot{border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);padding:10px 16px 12px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-mute);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
#spatial-root .rail-foot i{font-size:10px}

/* ═══ MAIN COLUMN ═══ */
#spatial-root .ss-main{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%}
#spatial-root .ss-ribbon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:11px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--surface-2);flex-shrink:0}
#spatial-root .ss-ribbon-l{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0}
#spatial-root .ss-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--signal);flex-shrink:0;animation:ss-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes ss-pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(34,136,131,.45)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(34,136,131,0)}}
#spatial-root .ss-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
#spatial-root .ss-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(10,10,10,.05);color:var(--ink-3);white-space:nowrap}
#spatial-root .ss-search{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center}
#spatial-root .ss-search i{position:absolute;left:10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-mute);pointer-events:none}
#spatial-root .ss-search input{font-size:12.5px;padding:7px 10px 7px 28px;border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink-3);width:170px;transition:width .15s}
#spatial-root .ss-search input:focus{outline:none;width:220px;border-color:var(--blue)}
#spatial-root .ss-ribbon-r{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#spatial-root .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;border:0;background:rgba(10,10,10,.05);color:var(--ink-3);cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:all .15s;white-space:nowrap}
#spatial-root .btn:hover{background:rgba(10,10,10,.09)}
#spatial-root .btn-primary{background:var(--ink);color:#fafaf6}
#spatial-root .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--ink-2)}
#spatial-root .btn-sm{padding:6px 12px;font-size:12px}
#spatial-root .btn.active{background:var(--signal);color:#fff}
#spatial-root .btn-danger{background:rgba(211,47,47,.09);color:#b3261e}
#spatial-root .btn-danger:hover{background:rgba(211,47,47,.16)}
#spatial-root .btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
#spatial-root .ribbon-divider{width:1px;height:22px;background:var(--hairline);margin:0 2px}

/* ─── CANVAS ─── */
#spatial-root .ss-canvas{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0;min-width:0;background:#0f172a}
#spatial-root .ss-canvas-el{width:100%;height:100%}
#spatial-root .ss-loading{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1000;background:rgba(15,23,42,.38);backdrop-filter:blur(1px);display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:11px;color:#fff;font-size:13px;pointer-events:none}
#spatial-root .ss-loading.show{display:flex}
#spatial-root .ss-spinner{width:28px;height:28px;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-top-color:var(--signal);border-radius:50%;animation:ss-spin .75s linear infinite}
@keyframes ss-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
#spatial-root .ss-toast{position:absolute;top:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:1400;background:rgba(15,23,42,.92);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.25);white-space:nowrap;max-width:calc(100% - 28px)}
#spatial-root .ss-toast.show{display:flex}
#spatial-root .ss-toast.err{background:rgba(179,38,30,.94)}
#spatial-root .leaflet-popup-content-wrapper{border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:0}
#spatial-root .leaflet-popup-content{margin:0;padding:11px 13px;font-family:inherit;min-width:170px}
#spatial-root .ss-pop-t{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
#spatial-root .ss-pop-s{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink-mute);margin-top:2px}
#spatial-root .ss-divicon{background:transparent;border:none}
#spatial-root .ss-pin{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 0;transform:rotate(-45deg);border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
#spatial-root .ss-pin i{transform:rotate(45deg);color:#fff;font-size:10px}
#spatial-root .ss-pin.sel{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(34,136,131,.35),0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}

/* ─── Floating panel base (docked cards over the map) ─── */
#spatial-root .float{position:absolute;z-index:850;width:var(--float-w);max-height:calc(100% - 28px);background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow-float);border:1px solid var(--hairline);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
#spatial-root .float.hidden{display:none}

/* ═══ VIEW TABS (Map / Layout / per-layer Attribute Tables) ═══ */
/* ArcGIS Pro-style: a tab strip above the canvas switches the WHOLE canvas
   area between the live Map, the Layout page, and any number of open
   Attribute Table tabs (one per layer, closable) - the rail (Layers
   checkboxes) and ribbon stay visible and usable throughout, only the
   content of .ss-canvas swaps. "Map" has no .canvas-view of its own - it's
   just whatever's left visible when no other tab's overlay is showing. */
#spatial-root .view-tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:0 14px;background:var(--surface-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);flex-shrink:0;overflow-x:auto}
#spatial-root .view-tab{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px 8px 16px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-mute);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
#spatial-root .view-tab:hover{color:var(--ink-3)}
#spatial-root .view-tab.active{color:var(--ink);border-bottom-color:var(--blue)}
#spatial-root .view-tab-close{border:none;background:transparent;color:inherit;opacity:.6;cursor:pointer;padding:2px;border-radius:4px;font-size:10px;display:flex}
#spatial-root .view-tab-close:hover{opacity:1;background:rgba(10,10,10,.08)}

/* Shared shell for anything that takes over .ss-canvas via a view tab
   (Layout, Attribute Tables, ...) - fills the same real estate the map
   normally gets, not a sidebar, not a viewport takeover. */
#spatial-root .canvas-view{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:500;background:var(--surface);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#spatial-root .canvas-view.hidden{display:none}

/* ═══ LAYOUT DESIGNER ═══ */
#spatial-root .layout-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);background:var(--surface-2);flex-wrap:wrap;flex-shrink:0}
#spatial-root .layout-toolbar-group{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-mute)}
#spatial-root .layout-toolbar select,#spatial-root .layout-toolbar input[type=text]{font-size:12.5px;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink-3)}
#spatial-root .layout-page-wrap{flex:1;overflow:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:28px;background:#ccccc4}
#spatial-root .layout-page-wrap canvas{background:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 28px rgba(10,10,10,.28);max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}
#spatial-root .float-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 13px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);flex-shrink:0;gap:8px}
#spatial-root .float-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
#spatial-root .float-close{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:rgba(10,10,10,.05);color:var(--ink-mute);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;transition:background .15s;flex-shrink:0}
#spatial-root .float-close:hover{background:rgba(10,10,10,.1);color:var(--ink)}
#spatial-root .float-body{overflow-y:auto;padding:12px 13px 14px;flex:1;min-height:20px}
#spatial-root .float-tabs{display:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);flex-shrink:0}
#spatial-root .float-tab{flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;padding:9px 6px;color:var(--ink-mute);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}
#spatial-root .tab-divider{flex:0 0 auto;width:1px;align-self:stretch;background:var(--hairline);margin:8px 1px}
#spatial-root .float-tab.active{color:var(--ink);border-bottom-color:var(--blue)}
#spatial-root .field{margin-bottom:10px}
#spatial-root .field label{display:block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink-mute);margin-bottom:4px}
#spatial-root .field input[type=text],#spatial-root .field input[type=number],#spatial-root .field input[type=email],#spatial-root .field select,#spatial-root .field textarea{width:100%;font-size:12.5px;padding:7px 9px;border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink-3)}
#spatial-root .field textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:50px}
#spatial-root .field input:focus,#spatial-root .field select:focus,#spatial-root .field textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--blue)}
#spatial-root .field-row{display:flex;gap:8px}
#spatial-root .field-row .field{flex:1}
#spatial-root .check-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-3);padding:5px 0;cursor:pointer}
#spatial-root .check-row input{accent-color:var(--blue);width:13px;height:13px;cursor:pointer}
#spatial-root .badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:99px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}
#spatial-root .b-blue{background:var(--blue-lt);color:var(--blue-dk)}
#spatial-root .b-green{background:var(--green-lt);color:var(--green-dk)}
#spatial-root .b-amber{background:var(--amber-lt);color:var(--amber-dk)}
#spatial-root .b-purple{background:var(--purple-lt);color:#3a3391}
#spatial-root .b-signal{background:var(--signal-soft);color:var(--signal-dark)}
#spatial-root .hint{font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-mute);line-height:1.5}
#spatial-root .divider-line{height:1px;background:var(--hairline);margin:11px 0}
#spatial-root .help-section{border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)}
#spatial-root .help-section summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink);padding:9px 4px;list-style:none;user-select:none}
#spatial-root .help-section summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#spatial-root .help-section summary::before{content:"▸";display:inline-block;width:12px;font-size:10px;color:var(--ink-mute);transition:transform .15s}
#spatial-root .help-section[open] summary::before{transform:rotate(90deg)}
#spatial-root .help-field{padding:5px 4px 8px 20px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5}
#spatial-root .help-field b{color:var(--ink-3);font-weight:700;display:block}
#spatial-root .help-field span{color:var(--ink-mute);display:block;margin-top:1px}

#spatial-root .layer-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 4px;border-radius:8px}
#spatial-root .layer-row:hover{background:rgba(10,10,10,.04)}
#spatial-root .layer-swatch{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:3px;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
#spatial-root .layer-name{flex:1;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-3);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#spatial-root .layer-count{font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-mute);flex-shrink:0}
#spatial-root .layer-row input{accent-color:var(--blue);width:14px;height:14px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
#spatial-root .attr-table-btn{border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-mute);cursor:pointer;padding:2px 4px;font-size:11px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:4px}
#spatial-root .attr-table-btn:hover{background:rgba(10,10,10,.08);color:var(--ink)}

/* Query / Process dock */
#spatial-root .dock{top:14px;left:14px}
#spatial-root .results-list{margin-top:2px}
#spatial-root .result-row{padding:8px 8px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;transition:background .15s}
#spatial-root .result-row:hover{background:rgba(10,10,10,.04)}
#spatial-root .result-row.sel{background:var(--blue-lt)}
#spatial-root .result-title{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#spatial-root .result-meta{color:var(--ink-mute);font-size:10.5px;margin-top:1px;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
#spatial-root .empty-note{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-mute);padding:14px 4px;text-align:center}
#spatial-root .proc-card{border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
#spatial-root .proc-card h4{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
#spatial-root .proc-readout{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-3);background:rgba(10,10,10,.035);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 9px;margin-top:6px;font-family:Consolas,'SFMono-Regular',monospace}

/* Feature detail panel (right side) */
#spatial-root .detail{top:14px;right:14px;width:320px}
#spatial-root .kv-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:4px 0;font-size:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)}
#spatial-root .kv-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
#spatial-root .kv-l{color:var(--ink-mute);flex-shrink:0}
#spatial-root .kv-v{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);text-align:right;word-break:break-word}
#spatial-root .kv-v a{color:var(--blue);text-decoration:underline}
#spatial-root .props-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:4px;font-size:11.5px}
#spatial-root .props-table td{padding:3px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);vertical-align:top}
#spatial-root .props-table td:first-child{color:var(--ink-mute);width:40%;word-break:break-word}
#spatial-root .props-table td:last-child{color:var(--ink-3);word-break:break-word}
#spatial-root .detail-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:10px}
#spatial-root .detail-actions .btn{flex:1;justify-content:center}
#spatial-root .share-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:5px 0;font-size:11.5px}
#spatial-root .share-row .su{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
#spatial-root .share-row .sx{background:none;border:none;color:var(--ink-mute);cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;padding:2px 4px}
#spatial-root .share-row .sx:hover{color:#b3261e}
#spatial-root .section-label{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink-mute);margin:12px 0 6px}
#spatial-root .section-label:first-child{margin-top:0}

/* Draw popover */
#spatial-root .draw-pop{top:52px;right:14px;width:180px}
#spatial-root .draw-opt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 9px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-3)}
#spatial-root .draw-opt:hover{background:rgba(10,10,10,.05)}
#spatial-root .draw-opt.active{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
#spatial-root .draw-opt i{width:14px;text-align:center;font-size:12px}

/* Modal */
#spatial-root .modal-scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,10,10,.45);z-index:2000;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}
#spatial-root .modal-scrim.show{display:flex}
#spatial-root .modal{width:420px;max-width:100%;max-height:88vh;background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow-float);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
#spatial-root .modal.modal-wide{width:760px}
#spatial-root .attr-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px}
#spatial-root .attr-table th{text-align:left;font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--ink-mute);padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--surface-2)}
#spatial-root .attr-table td{padding:7px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);color:var(--ink-3);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:220px}
#spatial-root .attr-table tr{cursor:pointer}
#spatial-root .attr-table tr:hover td{background:rgba(10,10,10,.035)}
#spatial-root .modal-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:15px 17px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);flex-shrink:0}
#spatial-root .modal-title{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
#spatial-root .modal-body{overflow-y:auto;padding:15px 17px;flex:1}
#spatial-root .modal-foot{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;padding:13px 17px;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);flex-shrink:0}
#spatial-root .import-summary{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-3);background:rgba(10,10,10,.035);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 11px;margin-bottom:10px}
#spatial-root .import-fail{font-size:11px;color:#b3261e;padding:2px 0}

/* Edit-mode banner */
#spatial-root .edit-bar{position:absolute;top:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:1300;background:var(--ink);color:#fafaf6;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 10px 9px 16px;display:none;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:12.5px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-float)}
#spatial-root .edit-bar.show{display:flex}
#spatial-root .edit-bar .btn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff}
#spatial-root .edit-bar .btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
#spatial-root .edit-bar .btn-primary{background:var(--signal)}

#spatial-root .geobar{position:absolute;left:10px;bottom:10px;z-index:800;background:rgba(15,23,42,.78);color:#d8dde6;font-family:Consolas,'SFMono-Regular',monospace;font-size:10.5px;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:6px;pointer-events:none;display:flex;gap:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
#spatial-root .leaflet-tooltip.feature-label{background:var(--label-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.9));border:1px solid var(--label-border,rgba(10,10,10,.18));border-radius:4px;padding:1px 6px;font-size:var(--label-font-size,10.5px);font-weight:var(--label-font-weight,700);font-style:var(--label-font-style,normal);color:var(--label-color,#2a2a26);box-shadow:none;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:none}
#spatial-root.label-style-halo .leaflet-tooltip.feature-label{background:transparent;border:none;padding:0;text-shadow:var(--label-halo-shadow,-1px -1px 0 #fff,1px -1px 0 #fff,-1px 1px 0 #fff,1px 1px 0 #fff,0 0 3px #fff)}
#spatial-root.label-style-plain .leaflet-tooltip.feature-label{background:transparent;border:none;padding:0}
#spatial-root .leaflet-tooltip-right.feature-label::before,
#spatial-root .leaflet-tooltip-left.feature-label::before{display:none}
#spatial-root .geobar span b{color:#fff;font-weight:600}

@media(max-width:900px){
  #spatial-root .app-rail{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;z-index:1200;transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .18s ease;box-shadow:8px 0 24px -8px rgba(10,10,10,.25)}
  #spatial-root .app-rail.open{transform:translateX(0)}
  #spatial-root .ss-main{width:100%}
  #spatial-root .rail-toggle-mobile{display:inline-flex!important}
  #spatial-root .float{width:min(var(--float-w),86vw)}
  #spatial-root .detail{width:min(320px,86vw)}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  #spatial-root .ss-title{display:none}
  #spatial-root .ss-search input{width:110px}
  #spatial-root .ss-search input:focus{width:150px}
}
#spatial-root .rail-toggle-mobile{display:none}
</style>

<div id="spatial-root">
  <div class="ss-ribbon">
    <div class="ss-ribbon-l">
      <button class="btn btn-sm rail-toggle-mobile" id="railToggleMobile"><i class="fa-solid fa-bars"></i></button>
      <div class="ss-dot"></div>
      <div class="ss-title">Map Viewer</div>
      <div class="ss-badge" id="ssSummaryBadge"><i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group"></i> — layers · — features</div>
      <div class="ss-search">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass"></i>
        <input type="text" id="ssSearch" placeholder="Search by title…">
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ss-ribbon-r">
      <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btnQuery" title="Query & filter"><i class="fa-solid fa-filter"></i>Query</button>
      <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btnProcess" title="Geoprocessing"><i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"></i>Geoprocessing</button>
      <div class="ribbon-divider"></div>
      <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btnDraw" title="Draw a new feature"><i class="fa-solid fa-pencil"></i>Draw</button>
      <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btnImport" title="Import GeoJSON, Shapefile, KML, GPX or CSV"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-import"></i>Import</button>
      <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btnExport" title="Export — choose layers and format"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-export"></i>Export</button>
      <div class="ribbon-divider"></div>
      <button class="btn btn-sm" id="btnHelp" title="Field-by-field reference for every tool"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-question"></i>Help</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Golden Layout builds the dockable Contents / Map / Properties
       workspace inside here at boot - see setupGoldenLayout(). The three
       panels' actual content lives in the detached holders below
       (#ssRail, #mapAreaHolder, #panelDetail), moved in (not cloned) so
       every existing event listener survives the move untouched. -->
  <div id="glContainer"></div>

  <nav class="app-rail" id="ssRail" style="display:none">
    <div class="rail-brand">
      <div class="rail-brand-mark"><i class="fa-solid fa-map-location-dot"></i></div>
      <div class="rail-brand-name">Map Viewer</div>
    </div>
    <div class="rail-nav">
      <div class="rail-group">
        <a class="rail-link active" href="/map-viewer"><i class="fa-solid fa-earth-africa"></i>Map Viewer</a>
        <a class="rail-link" href="/app/upande-spatial"><i class="fa-solid fa-gauge"></i>Desk Workspace</a>
      </div>
      <div class="rail-group">
        <div class="rail-group-label">Basemap</div>
        <div class="field" style="padding:0 0 10px">
          <select id="basemapSelect">
            <option value="street">Street (OpenStreetMap)</option>
            <option value="satellite">Satellite (Esri)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="rail-group">
        <div class="rail-group-label">Layers</div>
        <div class="field">
          <select id="farmFilter"><option value="">All farms</option></select>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0 0 8px"><label class="check-row" style="padding:0;flex:1"><input type="checkbox" id="labelsToggle" checked>Show labels on map</label><button class="btn-icon" id="labelSettingsBtn" title="Label style settings" style="border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:6px;width:26px;height:26px;background:var(--surface-2);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0"><i class="fa-solid fa-sliders" style="font-size:11px"></i></button></div>
        <div id="layerRows"><div class="empty-note">Loading layers…</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="rail-foot"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle" style="color:var(--signal)"></i>Live spatial data</div>
  </nav>

  <div id="mapAreaHolder" style="display:none">
    <div class="view-tabs">
      <div class="view-tab active" data-view="map" id="viewTabMap"><i class="fa-solid fa-map"></i>Map</div>
      <div class="view-tab" data-view="layout" id="viewTabLayout"><i class="fa-solid fa-print"></i>Layout</div>
    </div>

    <div class="ss-canvas">
      <div class="ss-canvas-el" id="ssMapEl"></div>
      <div class="ss-loading" id="ssLoading"><div class="ss-spinner"></div><span>Loading spatial features…</span></div>
      <div class="ss-toast" id="ssToast"></div>
      <div class="geobar" id="ssGeobar"><span id="geoZoom">Zoom —</span><span id="geoLL">— , —</span></div>

      <div class="edit-bar" id="editBar">
        <span><i class="fa-solid fa-draw-polygon"></i>  Editing geometry — drag points, then Save</span>
        <button class="btn btn-sm" id="editCancelBtn">Cancel</button>
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="editSaveBtn"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>Save</button>
      </div>

      <!-- QUERY / PROCESS DOCK -->
      <div class="float dock hidden" id="panelDock">
        <div class="float-head">
          <div class="float-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-filter"></i><span id="dockTitle">Query</span></div>
          <button class="float-close" data-close="panelDock"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i></button>
        </div>
        <div class="float-tabs">
          <div class="float-tab active" data-tab="query">Query</div>
          <div class="float-tab" data-tab="process">Geoprocessing</div>
          <div class="float-tab" data-tab="help">Help</div>
        </div>
        <div class="float-body dock-tab-content" id="tabQuery" data-tab-content="query">
          <div class="field">
            <label>Reference doctype</label>
            <select id="qRefDoctype"><option value="">Any</option></select>
          </div>
          <div class="field-row">
            <div class="field">
              <label>Geometry type</label>
              <select id="qGeomType">
                <option value="">Any</option>
                <option>Point</option><option>MultiPoint</option>
                <option>LineString</option><option>MultiLineString</option>
                <option>Polygon</option><option>MultiPolygon</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label>Layer</label>
              <select id="qLayer"><option value="">Any</option></select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="field">
            <label>Source module</label>
            <select id="qSourceModule"><option value="">Any</option></select>
          </div>
          <label class="check-row"><input type="checkbox" id="qBboxToggle">Only features in current map view</label>
          <div class="divider-line"></div>
          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center">
            <span class="section-label" style="margin:0">Results <span id="qResultCount"></span></span>
            <button class="btn btn-sm" id="qClearBtn">Clear</button>
          </div>
          <div class="results-list" id="qResults"><div class="empty-note">No filters applied — showing nothing to keep this list short. Set a filter or search above.</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="float-body dock-tab-content" id="tabProcess" data-tab-content="process" style="display:none">
          <div class="proc-card">
            <h4><i class="fa-solid fa-ruler-combined" style="color:var(--blue)"></i>Buffer</h4>
            <div class="hint" id="bufSourceHint">Click a feature on the map to use it as the buffer source.</div>
            <div class="field" style="margin-top:8px"><label>Distance (m)</label><input type="number" id="bufDistance" value="50" min="1"></div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:7px">
              <button class="btn btn-sm" id="bufPreviewBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center" disabled>Preview</button>
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="bufSaveBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center" disabled>Save as feature</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="proc-card">
            <h4><i class="fa-solid fa-ruler" style="color:var(--green)"></i>Measure distance</h4>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:8px">
              <button class="btn btn-sm" id="measStartBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center">Start</button>
              <button class="btn btn-sm" id="measClearBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center">Clear</button>
            </div>
            <div class="proc-readout" id="measReadout">0 points · 0 m</div>
          </div>
          <div class="proc-card">
            <h4><i class="fa-solid fa-crosshairs" style="color:var(--purple)"></i>Centroid</h4>
            <div class="hint" id="centSourceHint">Select a Polygon/MultiPolygon feature to compute its centroid.</div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:8px">
              <button class="btn btn-sm" id="centComputeBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center" disabled>Compute</button>
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="centSaveBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center" disabled>Save as feature</button>
            </div>
            <div class="proc-readout" id="centReadout" style="display:none"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="proc-card">
            <h4><i class="fa-solid fa-shapes" style="color:var(--amber)"></i>Area / Length</h4>
            <div class="proc-readout" id="alReadout">No feature selected.</div>
          </div>

          <div class="divider-line"></div>
          <div class="section-label">Vector tools</div>

          <div class="proc-card">
            <h4><i class="fa-solid fa-scissors" style="color:var(--amber)"></i>Clip</h4>
            <div class="field" style="margin-top:8px"><label>Feature A (to clip)</label><select id="gpClipA"></select></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Feature B (clip boundary — polygon)</label><select id="gpClipB"></select></div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:7px">
              <button class="btn btn-sm" id="gpClipPreviewBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center">Preview</button>
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="gpClipSaveBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center" disabled>Save as feature</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="proc-card">
            <h4><i class="fa-solid fa-object-group" style="color:var(--blue)"></i>Union</h4>
            <div class="field" style="margin-top:8px"><label>Feature A (polygon)</label><select id="gpUnionA"></select></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Feature B (polygon)</label><select id="gpUnionB"></select></div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:7px">
              <button class="btn btn-sm" id="gpUnionPreviewBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center">Preview</button>
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="gpUnionSaveBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center" disabled>Save as feature</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="proc-card">
            <h4><i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group" style="color:var(--green)"></i>Merge</h4>
            <div class="field" style="margin-top:8px"><label>Feature A</label><select id="gpMergeA"></select></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Feature B</label><select id="gpMergeB"></select></div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:7px">
              <button class="btn btn-sm" id="gpMergePreviewBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center">Preview</button>
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="gpMergeSaveBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center" disabled>Save as feature</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="proc-card">
            <h4><i class="fa-solid fa-code-branch" style="color:var(--purple)"></i>Spatial Join</h4>
            <div class="field" style="margin-top:8px"><label>Source feature</label><select id="gpJoinSource"></select></div>
            <div class="field-row">
              <div class="field"><label>Relation</label><select id="gpJoinPredicate"><option value="intersects">Intersects</option><option value="within">Source within target</option><option value="contains">Source contains target</option></select></div>
              <div class="field"><label>Target layer</label><select id="gpJoinLayer"></select></div>
            </div>
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="gpJoinRunBtn" style="width:100%;justify-content:center">Run join</button>
            <div id="gpJoinResult"></div>
          </div>

          <div class="proc-card">
            <h4><i class="fa-solid fa-fire" style="color:#b3261e"></i>Heatmap / Density</h4>
            <div class="field" style="margin-top:8px"><label>Point layer</label><select id="gpHeatLayer"></select></div>
            <div class="field-row">
              <div class="field"><label>Radius (px)</label><input type="number" id="gpHeatRadius" value="25" min="5" max="100"></div>
              <div class="field"><label>Blur (px)</label><input type="number" id="gpHeatBlur" value="15" min="0" max="60"></div>
            </div>
            <label class="check-row"><input type="checkbox" id="gpHeatShow">Show heatmap on map</label>
          </div>

          <div class="proc-card">
            <h4><i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group" style="color:#854F0B"></i>Weighted Overlay</h4>
            <div class="field" style="margin-top:8px"><label>Layer A</label><select class="wo-layer" id="woLayerA"></select></div>
            <div class="field-row">
              <div class="field"><label>Weight A</label><input type="number" id="woWeightA" value="0.5" min="0" max="1" step="0.05"></div>
              <div class="field"><label>Score source</label><select id="woModeA"><option value="uniform">Fixed value</option><option value="property">Property</option></select></div>
            </div>
            <div class="field-row">
              <div class="field" id="woFixedAField"><label>Score for every zone in A</label><input type="number" id="woFixedA" value="1"></div>
              <div class="field" id="woPropAField" style="display:none"><label>Numeric property</label><select id="woPropA"></select></div>
            </div>
            <div class="divider-line"></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Layer B</label><select class="wo-layer" id="woLayerB"></select></div>
            <div class="field-row">
              <div class="field"><label>Weight B</label><input type="number" id="woWeightB" value="0.5" min="0" max="1" step="0.05"></div>
              <div class="field"><label>Score source</label><select id="woModeB"><option value="uniform">Fixed value</option><option value="property">Property</option></select></div>
            </div>
            <div class="field-row">
              <div class="field" id="woFixedBField"><label>Score for every zone in B</label><input type="number" id="woFixedB" value="1"></div>
              <div class="field" id="woPropBField" style="display:none"><label>Numeric property</label><select id="woPropB"></select></div>
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:7px">
              <button class="btn btn-sm" id="woRunBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center">Run overlay</button>
              <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" id="woSaveBtn" style="flex:1;justify-content:center" disabled>Save results</button>
            </div>
            <div id="woResult"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="float-body dock-tab-content" id="tabHelp" data-tab-content="help" style="display:none">
          <details class="help-section" open>
            <summary>Layers (left sidebar)</summary>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Basemap</b><span>Street (OpenStreetMap) or Satellite (Esri World Imagery) - switch to Satellite to trace real-world features (farm boundaries, buildings, roads) as a digitizing reference when creating your own data.</span></div><div class="help-field"><b>Farm</b><span>Restricts every layer on the map to one farm, or shows all farms.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Show labels on map</b><span>Toggles permanent on-map text labels (each feature's title) on or off. When off, you only see a feature's title by clicking it.</span></div><div class="help-field"><b>Label style (sliders icon)</b><span>Font size, weight, italic, text color, and a Boxed/Halo/Plain background style (Halo - a white text outline with no box - reads best over the Satellite basemap). Changes apply live as you adjust them.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Layer checkbox</b><span>Shows or hides that layer's features on the map. Doesn't affect Query, Export, or other tools — those work from all loaded data regardless of visibility.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Table icon</b><span>Opens an Attribute Table tab listing every feature in that layer — no filtering needed first.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Sliders icon</b><span>Opens Layer Properties — lets you change the layer's display color.</span></div>
          </details>

          <details class="help-section">
            <summary>Query tab</summary>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Search by title…</b><span>Filters the map and results list by feature title as you type.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Reference doctype</b><span>Shows only features linked to a specific business record type (Farm, Warehouse, ...), or Any.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Geometry type</b><span>Restricts results to one geometry kind — Point, LineString, Polygon, etc.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Layer</b><span>Restricts results to one specific layer.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Source module</b><span>Restricts results to features created by a specific tool (e.g. "Map Viewer Import", "Map Viewer EPANET Plugin").</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Only features in current map view</b><span>Limits results to whatever's inside the map's current pan/zoom bounds.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Clear</b><span>Resets every filter above.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Results list</b><span>Only populates once at least one filter above is set (kept empty otherwise so it doesn't dump hundreds of rows by default). Click a row to select and view that feature.</span></div>
          </details>

          <details class="help-section">
            <summary>Draw & New Feature</summary>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Point / Line / Polygon / Rectangle</b><span>Pick a shape, then draw it directly on the map. Finishing a shape opens the New Feature form.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Title</b><span>The name shown on the map (as a label, if labels are on) and everywhere this feature is listed.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Reference doctype / Reference name</b><span>Optionally link this shape to an existing business record (e.g. Farm "Kapkolia") instead of leaving it standalone.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Feature role</b><span>Distinguishes multiple features on the same reference record — e.g. a Farm's Boundary vs. its Gate. Leave blank for a single, unambiguous feature per record.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Farm</b><span>Tags this feature so the sidebar's Farm filter can find it.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Notes</b><span>Free-text notes shown in the feature's detail panel.</span></div>
          </details>

          <details class="help-section">
            <summary>Import</summary>
            <div class="help-field"><b>File</b><span>Accepts GeoJSON/.json, Shapefile (as a .zip of .shp/.dbf/.prj — a lone .shp loses attributes and coordinate projection), KML/KMZ, GPX, or CSV with latitude/longitude columns.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Default reference doctype</b><span>Used only for an incoming feature that carries no reference of its own.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Default farm</b><span>Fallback farm tag applied to incoming features that don't already specify one.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Source module tag</b><span>Label stamped onto every imported feature, so you can find or filter them later (Query tab's Source module filter).</span></div>
          </details>

          <details class="help-section">
            <summary>Export</summary>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Format</b><span>GeoJSON and KML keep every geometry type and property. GPX turns points into waypoints and lines into tracks but can't represent polygons (skipped). CSV is points-only (lat/lon + flattened properties); lines and polygons are skipped. Shapefile export isn't available — no dependable no-build-step library for writing one exists yet (import still supports it).</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Layers / All / None</b><span>Choose exactly which layers' features are included in the download, independent of what's currently checked in the sidebar.</span></div>
          </details>

          <details class="help-section">
            <summary>Geoprocessing — Buffer, Measure, Centroid, Area/Length</summary>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Buffer — Distance (m)</b><span>How far out to expand a ring around the currently selected feature.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Buffer — Preview / Save as feature</b><span>Preview draws the ring on the map without saving; Save keeps it as a new standalone feature.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Measure distance — Start / Clear</b><span>Start begins recording map clicks into a line, showing the running total distance live. Clear resets it.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Centroid — Compute / Save as feature</b><span>Compute finds the geometric center point of the selected Polygon/MultiPolygon; Save keeps that point as a new feature.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Area / Length</b><span>Read-only, server-computed size of whatever feature is currently selected.</span></div>
          </details>

          <details class="help-section">
            <summary>Geoprocessing — Clip, Union, Merge, Spatial Join</summary>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Clip — Feature A / Feature B</b><span>Cuts A down to the part that falls inside polygon B. Exact for polygon or point A; for line geometry, A is clipped to B's bounding box only (an approximation, not a true boundary clip).</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Union — Feature A / Feature B</b><span>Merges two overlapping polygons into one combined shape. Both inputs must be polygons.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Merge — Feature A / Feature B</b><span>Combines two features of the same geometry family (both points, both lines, or both polygons) into one multi-part feature.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Spatial Join — Source feature</b><span>The feature whose spatial relationship to a layer you want to check.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Spatial Join — Relation</b><span>Intersects (touches or overlaps), Source within target, or Source contains target.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Spatial Join — Target layer</b><span>The layer to test every feature in. Read-only — results are listed, not saved.</span></div>
          </details>

          <details class="help-section">
            <summary>Geoprocessing — Heatmap & Weighted Overlay</summary>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Heatmap — Point layer</b><span>Which point layer's density/clustering to visualize (incidents, sightings, etc.).</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Heatmap — Radius / Blur</b><span>Radius controls how far each point's influence spreads in pixels; Blur softens the edges. Larger values merge nearby points into broader hotspots.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Weighted Overlay — Layer A / Layer B</b><span>The two polygon zone layers to combine (e.g. a flood buffer and a slope-risk zone). Must be two different layers with at least one polygon each.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Weighted Overlay — Weight</b><span>How much that layer counts toward the combined score (0–1). Doesn't have to sum to 1.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Weighted Overlay — Score source</b><span>"Fixed value" applies one score to every zone in that layer. "Property" reads an existing numeric field already on those features instead.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Weighted Overlay — Run overlay / Save results</b><span>Run previews the combined, colored zones on the map (this is a real geometric overlay — every overlap and leftover area is computed and correctly scored, not an approximation). Save keeps every resulting zone as a new feature carrying its combined score. For 3+ factors, save the result and overlay it again with the next layer.</span></div>
          </details>

          <details class="help-section">
            <summary>Layout (print designer)</summary>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Paper / Orientation</b><span>Sets the printed page size (A4/A3/Letter/Legal) and rotation.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Map title</b><span>Text banner printed at the top of the page. Leave blank to omit it.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Grid</b><span>Draws a latitude/longitude reference grid over the map, aligned to the coordinates actually shown.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Neatline</b><span>A decorative double-line border framing the map area.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Scale bar / North arrow</b><span>Standard cartographic elements — the scale bar's distance is computed from the current zoom level.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Legend / position</b><span>Lists currently visible layers and their colors, placed in the chosen page corner.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Refresh map</b><span>Re-captures the live map. Needed after panning, zooming, or changing layers/farm while this tab is open — the preview otherwise reuses the last capture for speed.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Format</b><span>PNG, JPG, or PDF — PDF fills the exact paper size chosen above.</span></div>
          </details>

          <details class="help-section">
            <summary>Attribute Table & Layer Properties</summary>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Attribute Table search</b><span>Filters the open table by title or farm.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Attribute Table row click</b><span>Switches back to the Map tab, selects that feature, and zooms to it.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Layer Properties — Color</b><span>Updates every Spatial Entity Config row that uses this layer name, so the color stays consistent everywhere it's referenced — not just on this map session.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Layer Properties — Configuration list</b><span>Read-only: which doctype(s), feature role(s), and geometry type(s) actually map to this layer.</span></div>
          </details>

          <details class="help-section">
            <summary>EPANET plugin (water network simulation)</summary>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Network / Create</b><span>Pick an existing water network or create a new one to build on. Set a farm on the new network so its own pipe network (junctions, valves, reservoirs) stays separate from every other farm's - the network dropdown then only shows that farm's networks (plus any farm-less ones) whenever the map's global farm filter is set. Each network simulates completely independently regardless.</span></div><div class="help-field"><b>Network options (gear icon)</b><span>Hydraulics (solver trials/accuracy, demand model), Time (duration and timesteps - 0 duration runs a single steady-state snapshot, anything above runs a real extended-period simulation), Water Quality (None/Chemical/Age/Trace analysis), Energy (pump price/efficiency), and Reactions (bulk/wall decay coefficients). Saved per network.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Add node — role / Place</b><span>Choose Junction, Tank, or Reservoir, click Place, then click the map to position it — a form for its hydraulic properties (elevation, demand, etc.) opens immediately after.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Add link — role / Draw</b><span>Choose Pipe, Pump, or Valve, click Draw, then click a start point and an end point. Moving the cursor within 5m of an existing node shows a dashed highlight ring around it — click while it's highlighted to connect exactly to that node's coordinate. Clicking with nothing highlighted leaves that end unconnected, and it gets skipped when you run the simulation.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Element list</b><span>Every node/link in the selected network, with a delete button for each.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Run simulation</b><span>Builds a hydraulic model from the network's elements and solves it with EPANET's engine.</span></div>
            <div class="help-field"><b>Show results on map</b><span>Overlays the last simulation's results on the network geometry, with a color-ramp legend showing the active scale. Node color and Link color pick which result (Pressure/Head for nodes, Flow/Velocity for links) drives the ramp; pipe line-width still separately encodes flow magnitude.</span></div>
          </details>
        </div>

      </div>

      <!-- DRAW POPOVER -->
      <div class="float draw-pop hidden" id="panelDraw">
        <div class="float-head">
          <div class="float-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-pencil"></i>Draw</div>

        </div>

      <!-- LAYOUT DESIGNER — fills the same .ss-canvas real estate the map
           normally occupies, switched to via the Map/Layout view tabs above

           The rail (Layers checkboxes) and ribbon stay visible either way. -->

            <select id="layoutLegendPos"><option value="br">Bottom right</option><option value="bl">Bottom left</option><option value="tr">Top right</option><option value="tl">Top left</option></select>
          </div>
          <div class="ribbon-divider"></div>
          <button class="btn btn-sm" id="layoutRefreshBtn" title="Re-capture the map (use after panning/zooming, or after changing layers on the Map tab)"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i>Refresh map</button>
          <select id="layoutFormat"><option value="png">PNG</option><option value="jpg">JPG</option><option value="pdf">PDF</option></select>

      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- FEATURE DETAIL PANEL - the always-on Properties panel, no longer a
       floating popover: promoted to its own Golden Layout component. -->
  <div class="detail props-panel" id="panelDetail" style="display:none">

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const BASE = window.location.origin;
const API = "upande_spatial.api.spatial.";

// ─────────────────────────────  API wrapper  ─────────────────────────────
async function callMethod(method, args){
  const r = await fetch(BASE+"/api/method/"+method, {
    method:"POST", credentials:"include",
    headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Frappe-CSRF-Token": window.csrf_token || (window.frappe && frappe.csrf_token) || ""},
    body: JSON.stringify(args||{})
  });
  let j = {};
  try{ j = await r.json(); }catch(e){}
  if(!r.ok){
    let msg = "HTTP "+r.status;
    if(j._server_messages){
      try{
        const parsed = JSON.parse(j._server_messages);
        const first = parsed[0];
        if(first){ try{ const obj = JSON.parse(first); msg = (obj && obj.message) || first; }catch(e){ msg = first; } }
      }catch(e){}
    } else if(j.exception){
      const line = String(j.exception).split("\n").pop();
      if(line) msg = line;
    } else if(j.message && typeof j.message === "string"){
      msg = j.message;
    }
    throw new Error(msg);
  }
  if(j.exc) throw new Error(j.exc);
  return j.message;
}
function escHtml(s){ if(s==null) return ""; return String(s).replace(/&/g,"&").replace(/</g,"<").replace(/>/g,">").replace(/"/g,""").replace(/'/g,"'"); }
function todayISO(){ return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); }
function fmtNum(n, d){ if(n==null || isNaN(n)) return "—"; d = d==null?1:d; return Number(n).toLocaleString(undefined,{maximumFractionDigits:d}); }
function toast(msg, isErr){
  const t = document.getElementById("ssToast");
  t.textContent = msg; t.className = "ss-toast show" + (isErr?" err":"");
  clearTimeout(toast._t);
  toast._t = setTimeout(()=>{ t.classList.remove("show"); }, isErr?5000:2800);
}
function showLoading(v){ document.getElementById("ssLoading").classList.toggle("show", !!v); }

// ─────────────────────────────  State  ─────────────────────────────
const state = {
  map: null,
  geoLayer: null,          // the currently-rendered L.geoJSON layer group
  masterFC: {type:"FeatureCollection", features:[]},  // loaded from get_features_geojson (farm-scoped)
  layerMeta: [],            // from get_layers()
  layerVisible: {},         // layer_name -> bool
  showLabels: true,         // persistent on-map text labels (each feature's title), not just click-to-popup
  liveSymbology: {},        // layer_name -> {color, line_width, fill_opacity} - unsaved Layer Properties edits, previewed on the map immediately
  farmSet: new Set(),
  refDoctypes: [],          // from get_referenced_doctypes()
  featureLayerByName: {},   // spatial feature name -> leaflet layer
  metaByName: {},           // spatial feature name -> list_features() row (carries source_module, which get_features_geojson doesn't expose)
  selectedName: null,
  selectedDetail: null,     // full get_feature() payload for the selected feature
  drawnItems: null,         // L.FeatureGroup that leaflet-draw draws new shapes into
  drawHandler: null,
  drawMode: null,
  editGroup: null,
  editHandler: null,
  editMeta: null,           // {reference_doctype, reference_name, feature_role, farm, title}
  filters: {title:"", refDoctype:"", geomType:"", layer:"", sourceModule:"", bbox:false},
  measure: {active:false, points:[], layer:null},
  importParsed: null
};

const PALETTE = ["#185FA5","#3B6D11","#854F0B","#534AB7","#228883","#b3261e","#0C447C"];
function colorForLayer(name){
  let h = 0; for(let i=0;i<(name||"").length;i++) h = (h*31 + name.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  return PALETTE[h % PALETTE.length];
}
// Live Layer Properties edits (unsaved, previewed instantly) win over the
// persisted per-feature values get_features_geojson stamped on, which in
// turn win over the hardcoded defaults this app always used before layers
// had any configurable symbology at all.
function featureColor(f){
  const layer = (f.properties && f.properties._layer) || "Uncategorized";
  const live = state.liveSymbology[layer];
  if(live && live.color) return live.color;
  return (f.properties && f.properties.color) || colorForLayer(layer);
}
function featureWeight(f){
  const layer = (f.properties && f.properties._layer) || "Uncategorized";
  const live = state.liveSymbology[layer];
  if(live && live.line_width) return live.line_width;
  if(f.properties && f.properties.line_width) return f.properties.line_width;
  return f.geometry.type.includes("Line") ? 4 : 2.5;
}
function featureFillOpacity(f){
  const layer = (f.properties && f.properties._layer) || "Uncategorized";
  const live = state.liveSymbology[layer];
  if(live && live.fill_opacity != null) return live.fill_opacity;
  if(f.properties && f.properties.fill_opacity != null) return f.properties.fill_opacity;
  return f.geometry.type.includes("Polygon") ? 0.18 : 0;
}
// Spatial Entity Config's color/marker_icon fields are admin-controlled and
// low risk, but they still flow into style="..." attribute strings and
// class="..." attribute strings built via innerHTML below - cheap to
// validate before trusting them there rather than assume they're always
// well-formed. Falls back to a safe default when the value doesn't look
// like a hex color / a plain icon-name slug.
function safeColor(c){ return (typeof c === "string" && /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$/.test(c)) ? c : null; }
function safeIconSlug(s){ return (typeof s === "string" && /^[a-z0-9-]+$/i.test(s)) ? s : null; }

// ─────────────────────────────  Map init  ─────────────────────────────
function initMap(){
  state.map = L.map("ssMapEl", {zoomControl:false, attributionControl:true}).setView([-1.29, 36.82], 12);
  L.control.zoom({position:"bottomright"}).addTo(state.map);

  // Both tile providers send CORS headers - required for Layout/Export's canvas
  // capture to read the map back out without it coming back tainted. Esri's World
  // Imagery is free and keyless, same as OSM, so satellite needs no account/API key.
  state.baseLayers = {
    street: L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
      maxZoom:19, attribution:"© OpenStreetMap contributors", crossOrigin: true,
    }),
    satellite: L.tileLayer("https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}", {
      maxZoom:19, attribution:"Tiles © Esri", crossOrigin: true,
    }),
  };
  state.activeBasemap = "street";
  state.baseLayers.street.addTo(state.map);

  document.getElementById("basemapSelect").addEventListener("change", (e)=>{
    const next = e.target.value;
    if(next === state.activeBasemap) return;
    state.map.removeLayer(state.baseLayers[state.activeBasemap]);
    state.baseLayers[next].addTo(state.map);
    state.activeBasemap = next;
    if(!document.getElementById("layoutOverlay").classList.contains("hidden")) refreshLayoutPreview(true);
  });

  state.drawnItems = new L.FeatureGroup();
  state.map.addLayer(state.drawnItems);

  state.map.on("mousemove", (e)=>{
    document.getElementById("geoLL").textContent = e.latlng.lat.toFixed(5)+" , "+e.latlng.lng.toFixed(5);
  });
  state.map.on("zoomend", ()=>{
    document.getElementById("geoZoom").textContent = "Zoom "+state.map.getZoom();
  });
  document.getElementById("geoZoom").textContent = "Zoom "+state.map.getZoom();

  state.map.on(L.Draw.Event.CREATED, onDrawCreated);
  state.map.on("moveend", ()=>{ if(state.filters.bbox) renderMap(); });
}

// ─────────────────────────────  Data loading  ─────────────────────────────
async function loadAll(farm){
  showLoading(true);
  try{
    const [layers, refDoctypes, fc, rows] = await Promise.all([
      callMethod(API+"get_layers", {}),
      callMethod(API+"get_referenced_doctypes", {}),
      callMethod(API+"get_features_geojson", farm ? {farm:farm} : {}),
      callMethod(API+"list_features", farm ? {farm:farm} : {})
    ]);
    state.layerMeta = layers || [];
    state.refDoctypes = refDoctypes || [];
    state.masterFC = fc || {type:"FeatureCollection", features:[]};

    // get_features_geojson's properties don't carry source_module - list_features
    // does, so build a lookup off it purely for that one filter dimension.
    state.metaByName = {};
    (rows||[]).forEach(r=>{ state.metaByName[r.name] = r; });

    state.layerMeta.forEach(l=>{ if(!(l.layer_name in state.layerVisible)) state.layerVisible[l.layer_name] = true; });
    state.farmSet = new Set();
    state.masterFC.features.forEach(f=>{ if(f.properties && f.properties._farm) state.farmSet.add(f.properties._farm); });

    populateFarmDropdowns();
    populateRefDoctypeDropdowns();
    populateLayerDropdownAndRows();
    populateGeoprocessingDropdowns();
    populateHeatLayerSelect();
    populateWeightedOverlayLayers();
    if(document.getElementById("gpHeatShow").checked) updateHeatmap(); // keep it in sync with reloaded data
    renderMap();
    await refreshSummaryBadge();
  }catch(e){
    toast("Failed to load spatial data: "+e.message, true);
  }finally{
    showLoading(false);
  }
}

function populateLayerDropdownAndRows(){

    state.layerMeta.map(l=>`<option value="${escHtml(l.layer_name)}">${escHtml(l.layer_name)}</option>`).join("");

  // distinct values actually in use come off list_features (state.metaByName).

  sourceSel.value = curSource && modules.has(curSource) ? curSource : "";

  const counts = {};
  state.masterFC.features.forEach(f=>{
    const l = (f.properties && f.properties._layer) || "Uncategorized";

  });

  const rows = state.layerMeta.map(l=>{

// ─────────────────────────────  Rendering  ─────────────────────────────
function filteredFeatures(){
  const f = state.filters;
  let feats = state.masterFC.features.filter(feat=>{
    const p = feat.properties || {};
    const layer = p._layer || "Uncategorized";
    if(state.layerVisible[layer] === false) return false;
    if(f.title && !String(p._title||"").toLowerCase().includes(f.title.toLowerCase())) return false;
    if(f.refDoctype && p._reference_doctype !== f.refDoctype) return false;
    if(f.geomType && feat.geometry && feat.geometry.type !== f.geomType) return false;
    if(f.layer && layer !== f.layer) return false;
    if(f.sourceModule){
      const meta = state.metaByName[p._spatial_feature_name];
      if(!meta || meta.source_module !== f.sourceModule) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
  if(f.bbox && state.map){
    const b = state.map.getBounds();
    feats = feats.filter(feat=>{
      try{
        const pt = turf.pointOnFeature(feat);
        const c = pt.geometry.coordinates;
        return b.contains(L.latLng(c[1], c[0]));
      }catch(e){ return true; }
    });
  }
  return feats;
}

function pinIcon(color, iconClass){
  // color/iconClass ultimately trace back to Spatial Entity Config's
  // color/marker_icon fields (admin-controlled, but not validated at the
  // doctype level) - validate before trusting them in this innerHTML-built
  // style/class attribute string, same reasoning as safeColor/safeIconSlug
  // above.
  const safeC = safeColor(color) || "#185FA5";
  const safeI = safeIconSlug(iconClass) || "fa-map-pin";
  return L.divIcon({
    className:"ss-divicon",
    html:`<div class="ss-pin" style="background:${safeC}"><i class="fa-solid ${safeI}"></i></div>`,
    iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,22], popupAnchor:[0,-20]
  });
}

// ───────────────────────── Label style settings ─────────────────────────
// Live-appliable via CSS custom properties on #spatial-root - changing a
// setting restyles every already-rendered tooltip instantly with zero
// re-render, since the browser recomputes var() on the next paint. Style
// variants (Boxed/Halo/Plain) are separate rules gated by a class instead
// of trying to cram three different background/shadow strategies into one
// parametrized rule.
const DEFAULT_LABEL_SETTINGS = {fontSize:10.5, bold:true, italic:false, color:"#2a2a26", style:"boxed", bgColor:"#ffffff", bgOpacity:0.9, haloColor:"#ffffff"};
let labelSettings = {...DEFAULT_LABEL_SETTINGS};

function hexToRgba(hex, alpha){
  const r = parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16), g = parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16), b = parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16);
  return `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${alpha})`;
}

function applyLabelStyle(s){
  const root = document.getElementById("spatial-root");
  root.style.setProperty("--label-font-size", s.fontSize+"px");
  root.style.setProperty("--label-font-weight", s.bold ? "700" : "400");
  root.style.setProperty("--label-font-style", s.italic ? "italic" : "normal");
  root.style.setProperty("--label-color", s.color);
  root.classList.remove("label-style-halo", "label-style-plain");
  if(s.style === "halo"){
    root.classList.add("label-style-halo");
    const hc = s.haloColor;
    root.style.setProperty("--label-halo-shadow", `-1px -1px 0 ${hc},1px -1px 0 ${hc},-1px 1px 0 ${hc},1px 1px 0 ${hc},0 0 3px ${hc}`);
  } else if(s.style === "plain"){
    root.classList.add("label-style-plain");
  } else {
    root.style.setProperty("--label-bg", hexToRgba(s.bgColor, s.bgOpacity));
  }
}

function renderMap(){
  if(state.geoLayer){ state.map.removeLayer(state.geoLayer); }
  state.featureLayerByName = {};
  const feats = filteredFeatures();

  state.geoLayer = L.geoJSON({type:"FeatureCollection", features:feats}, {
    pointToLayer:(feature, latlng)=>{
      const color = featureColor(feature);
      const iconClass = feature.properties.marker_icon ? ("fa-"+feature.properties.marker_icon) : "fa-map-pin";
      return L.marker(latlng, {icon: pinIcon(color, iconClass)});
    },
    style:(feature)=>({
      color: featureColor(feature), weight: featureWeight(feature),
      fillColor: featureColor(feature), fillOpacity: featureFillOpacity(feature), opacity: .9
    }),
    onEachFeature:(feature, layer)=>{
      const name = feature.properties._spatial_feature_name;
      state.featureLayerByName[name] = layer;
      const title = feature.properties._title || name;
      layer.bindPopup(`<div class="ss-pop-t">${escHtml(title)}</div><div class="ss-pop-s">${escHtml(feature.properties._layer||"—")} · ${escHtml(feature.geometry.type)}</div>`);
      layer.on("click", ()=>{ selectFeature(name); });
      // Persistent on-map labels - this is what actually tells two overlapping
      // Farm Boundary polygons (same color, same layer) apart at a glance,
      // instead of needing to click each one to see its popup.
      if(state.showLabels && feature.properties._title){
        const isPoint = feature.geometry.type==="Point" || feature.geometry.type==="MultiPoint";
        layer.bindTooltip(feature.properties._title, {
          permanent: true, className: "feature-label",
          direction: isPoint ? "right" : "center",
          offset: isPoint ? [10,0] : [0,0],
        });
      }
    }
  }).addTo(state.map);

  document.getElementById("qResultCount").textContent = "("+feats.length+")";
  renderQueryResults(feats);
}

function renderQueryResults(feats){
  const box = document.getElementById("qResults");
  const anyFilter = state.filters.title || state.filters.refDoctype || state.filters.geomType || state.filters.layer || state.filters.sourceModule || state.filters.bbox;
  if(!anyFilter){
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">Set a filter or search above to list matching features.</div>';
    return;
  }
  if(!feats.length){ box.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">No features match.</div>'; return; }
  box.innerHTML = feats.map(f=>{
    const name = f.properties._spatial_feature_name;
    const sel = name === state.selectedName ? " sel" : "";
    return `<div class="result-row${sel}" data-name="${escHtml(name)}">
      <div class="result-title">${escHtml(f.properties._title || name)}</div>
      <div class="result-meta"><span class="badge b-blue">${escHtml(f.properties._layer||"—")}</span>${escHtml(f.geometry.type)}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
  box.querySelectorAll(".result-row").forEach(row=>{
    row.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      const name = row.dataset.name;
      const layer = state.featureLayerByName[name];
      if(layer){
        if(layer.getBounds) state.map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds(), {maxZoom:17});
        else if(layer.getLatLng) state.map.setView(layer.getLatLng(), 17);
      }
      selectFeature(name);
    });
  });
}

// ─────────────────────────────  Feature detail / edit / delete  ─────────────────────────────
async function selectFeature(name){
  state.selectedName = name;
  openPanel("panelDetail");
  document.getElementById("detailBody").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">Loading…</div>';
  try{
    const d = await callMethod(API+"get_feature", {name:name});
    state.selectedDetail = d;
    renderDetail(d);
    updateProcessHints(d);
    Object.values(state.featureLayerByName).forEach(l=>{ if(l.setIcon) return; });
  }catch(e){
    document.getElementById("detailBody").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">Could not load feature: '+escHtml(e.message)+'</div>';
  }
}

        : `<a href="/app/${encodeURIComponent(d.reference_doctype.toLowerCase().replace(/ /g,"-"))}/${encodeURIComponent(d.reference_name)}" target="_blank">${escHtml(d.reference_doctype)} · ${escHtml(d.reference_name)}</a>`)
    : "—";
  const sizeRow = d.geometry_type && d.geometry_type.includes("Polygon")
    ? `<div class="kv-row"><span class="kv-l">Area</span><span class="kv-v">${fmtNum(d.area_sq_m,1)} m²</span></div>`
    : (d.geometry_type && d.geometry_type.includes("Line")
      ? `<div class="kv-row"><span class="kv-l">Length</span><span class="kv-v">${fmtNum(d.length_m,1)} m</span></div>`

  if(d.properties && Object.keys(d.properties).length){
    propsHtml = '<table class="props-table">' + Object.entries(d.properties).map(([k,v])=>
      `<tr><td>${escHtml(k)}</td><td>${escHtml(typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : v)}</td></tr>`).join("") + '</table>';

    <div class="kv-row"><span class="kv-l">Layer</span><span class="kv-v"><span class="badge b-blue">${escHtml(d.name && state.masterFC ? (findLayerFor(d.name)||"—") : "—")}</span></span></div>
