<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const BASE = window.location.origin;
const API = "upande_spatial.api.spatial.";

// ─────────────────────────────  API wrapper  ─────────────────────────────
async function callMethod(method, args){
  const r = await fetch(BASE+"/api/method/"+method, {
    method:"POST", credentials:"include",
    headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json","X-Frappe-CSRF-Token": window.csrf_token || (window.frappe && frappe.csrf_token) || ""},
    body: JSON.stringify(args||{})
  });
  let j = {};
  try{ j = await r.json(); }catch(e){}
  if(!r.ok){
    let msg = "HTTP "+r.status;
    if(j._server_messages){
      try{
        const parsed = JSON.parse(j._server_messages);
        const first = parsed[0];
        if(first){ try{ const obj = JSON.parse(first); msg = (obj && obj.message) || first; }catch(e){ msg = first; } }
      }catch(e){}
    } else if(j.exception){
      const line = String(j.exception).split("\n").pop();
      if(line) msg = line;
    } else if(j.message && typeof j.message === "string"){
      msg = j.message;
    }
    throw new Error(msg);
  }
  if(j.exc) throw new Error(j.exc);
  return j.message;
}
function escHtml(s){ if(s==null) return ""; return String(s).replace(/&/g,"&").replace(/</g,"<").replace(/>/g,">").replace(/"/g,""").replace(/'/g,"'"); }
function todayISO(){ return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); }
function fmtNum(n, d){ if(n==null || isNaN(n)) return "—"; d = d==null?1:d; return Number(n).toLocaleString(undefined,{maximumFractionDigits:d}); }
function toast(msg, isErr){
  const t = document.getElementById("ssToast");
  t.textContent = msg; t.className = "ss-toast show" + (isErr?" err":"");
  clearTimeout(toast._t);
  toast._t = setTimeout(()=>{ t.classList.remove("show"); }, isErr?5000:2800);
}
function showLoading(v){ document.getElementById("ssLoading").classList.toggle("show", !!v); }

// ─────────────────────────────  State  ─────────────────────────────
const state = {
  map: null,
  geoLayer: null,          // the currently-rendered L.geoJSON layer group
  masterFC: {type:"FeatureCollection", features:[]},  // loaded from get_features_geojson (farm-scoped)
  layerMeta: [],            // from get_layers()
  layerVisible: {},         // layer_name -> bool
  showLabels: true,         // persistent on-map text labels (each feature's title), not just click-to-popup
  liveSymbology: {},        // layer_name -> {color, line_width, fill_opacity} - unsaved Layer Properties edits, previewed on the map immediately
  farmSet: new Set(),
  refDoctypes: [],          // from get_referenced_doctypes()
  featureLayerByName: {},   // spatial feature name -> leaflet layer
  metaByName: {},           // spatial feature name -> list_features() row (carries source_module, which get_features_geojson doesn't expose)
  selectedName: null,
  selectedDetail: null,     // full get_feature() payload for the selected feature
  drawnItems: null,         // L.FeatureGroup that leaflet-draw draws new shapes into
  drawHandler: null,
  drawMode: null,
  editGroup: null,
  editHandler: null,
  editMeta: null,           // {reference_doctype, reference_name, feature_role, farm, title}
  filters: {title:"", refDoctype:"", geomType:"", layer:"", sourceModule:"", bbox:false},
  measure: {active:false, points:[], layer:null},
  importParsed: null
};

const PALETTE = ["#185FA5","#3B6D11","#854F0B","#534AB7","#228883","#b3261e","#0C447C"];
function colorForLayer(name){
  let h = 0; for(let i=0;i<(name||"").length;i++) h = (h*31 + name.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  return PALETTE[h % PALETTE.length];
}
// Live Layer Properties edits (unsaved, previewed instantly) win over the
// persisted per-feature values get_features_geojson stamped on, which in
// turn win over the hardcoded defaults this app always used before layers
// had any configurable symbology at all.
function featureColor(f){
  const layer = (f.properties && f.properties._layer) || "Uncategorized";
  const live = state.liveSymbology[layer];
  if(live && live.color) return live.color;
  return (f.properties && f.properties.color) || colorForLayer(layer);
}
function featureWeight(f){
  const layer = (f.properties && f.properties._layer) || "Uncategorized";
  const live = state.liveSymbology[layer];
  if(live && live.line_width) return live.line_width;
  if(f.properties && f.properties.line_width) return f.properties.line_width;
  return f.geometry.type.includes("Line") ? 4 : 2.5;
}
function featureFillOpacity(f){
  const layer = (f.properties && f.properties._layer) || "Uncategorized";
  const live = state.liveSymbology[layer];
  if(live && live.fill_opacity != null) return live.fill_opacity;
  if(f.properties && f.properties.fill_opacity != null) return f.properties.fill_opacity;
  return f.geometry.type.includes("Polygon") ? 0.18 : 0;
}
// Spatial Entity Config's color/marker_icon fields are admin-controlled and
// low risk, but they still flow into style="..." attribute strings and
// class="..." attribute strings built via innerHTML below - cheap to
// validate before trusting them there rather than assume they're always
// well-formed. Falls back to a safe default when the value doesn't look
// like a hex color / a plain icon-name slug.
function safeColor(c){ return (typeof c === "string" && /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$/.test(c)) ? c : null; }
function safeIconSlug(s){ return (typeof s === "string" && /^[a-z0-9-]+$/i.test(s)) ? s : null; }

// ─────────────────────────────  Map init  ─────────────────────────────
function initMap(){
  state.map = L.map("ssMapEl", {zoomControl:false, attributionControl:true}).setView([-1.29, 36.82], 12);
  L.control.zoom({position:"bottomright"}).addTo(state.map);

  // Both tile providers send CORS headers - required for Layout/Export's canvas
  // capture to read the map back out without it coming back tainted. Esri's World
  // Imagery is free and keyless, same as OSM, so satellite needs no account/API key.
  state.baseLayers = {
    street: L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
      maxZoom:19, attribution:"© OpenStreetMap contributors", crossOrigin: true,
    }),
    satellite: L.tileLayer("https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}", {
      maxZoom:19, attribution:"Tiles © Esri", crossOrigin: true,
    }),
  };
  state.activeBasemap = "street";
  state.baseLayers.street.addTo(state.map);

  document.getElementById("basemapSelect").addEventListener("change", (e)=>{
    const next = e.target.value;
    if(next === state.activeBasemap) return;
    state.map.removeLayer(state.baseLayers[state.activeBasemap]);
    state.baseLayers[next].addTo(state.map);
    state.activeBasemap = next;
    if(!document.getElementById("layoutOverlay").classList.contains("hidden")) refreshLayoutPreview(true);
  });

  state.drawnItems = new L.FeatureGroup();
  state.map.addLayer(state.drawnItems);

  state.map.on("mousemove", (e)=>{
    document.getElementById("geoLL").textContent = e.latlng.lat.toFixed(5)+" , "+e.latlng.lng.toFixed(5);
  });
  state.map.on("zoomend", ()=>{
    document.getElementById("geoZoom").textContent = "Zoom "+state.map.getZoom();
  });
  document.getElementById("geoZoom").textContent = "Zoom "+state.map.getZoom();

  state.map.on(L.Draw.Event.CREATED, onDrawCreated);
  state.map.on("moveend", ()=>{ if(state.filters.bbox) renderMap(); });
}

// ─────────────────────────────  Data loading  ─────────────────────────────
async function loadAll(farm){
  showLoading(true);
  try{
    const [layers, refDoctypes, fc, rows] = await Promise.all([
      callMethod(API+"get_layers", {}),
      callMethod(API+"get_referenced_doctypes", {}),
      callMethod(API+"get_features_geojson", farm ? {farm:farm} : {}),
      callMethod(API+"list_features", farm ? {farm:farm} : {})
    ]);
    state.layerMeta = layers || [];
    state.refDoctypes = refDoctypes || [];
    state.masterFC = fc || {type:"FeatureCollection", features:[]};

    // get_features_geojson's properties don't carry source_module - list_features
    // does, so build a lookup off it purely for that one filter dimension.
    state.metaByName = {};
    (rows||[]).forEach(r=>{ state.metaByName[r.name] = r; });

    state.layerMeta.forEach(l=>{ if(!(l.layer_name in state.layerVisible)) state.layerVisible[l.layer_name] = true; });
    state.farmSet = new Set();
    state.masterFC.features.forEach(f=>{ if(f.properties && f.properties._farm) state.farmSet.add(f.properties._farm); });

    populateFarmDropdowns();
    populateRefDoctypeDropdowns();
    populateLayerDropdownAndRows();
    populateGeoprocessingDropdowns();
    populateHeatLayerSelect();
    populateWeightedOverlayLayers();
    if(document.getElementById("gpHeatShow").checked) updateHeatmap(); // keep it in sync with reloaded data
    renderMap();
    await refreshSummaryBadge();
  }catch(e){
    toast("Failed to load spatial data: "+e.message, true);
  }finally{
    showLoading(false);
  }
}

async function refreshSummaryBadge(){
  try{
    const farm = document.getElementById("farmFilter").value || undefined;
    const summary = await callMethod(API+"get_feature_summary", farm?{farm:farm}:{});
    const layerCount = (summary.by_layer||[]).length;
    document.getElementById("ssSummaryBadge").innerHTML =
      '<i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group"></i> '+layerCount+" layers · "+summary.total+" features";
  }catch(e){ /* summary badge is decorative - don't block the page on it */ }
}

function populateFarmDropdowns(){
  const farms = Array.from(state.farmSet).sort();
  const sel = document.getElementById("farmFilter");
  const cur = sel.value;
  sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">All farms</option>' + farms.map(f=>`<option value="${escHtml(f)}">${escHtml(f)}</option>`).join("");
  sel.value = cur && farms.includes(cur) ? cur : "";
  document.getElementById("farmDatalist").innerHTML = farms.map(f=>`<option value="${escHtml(f)}">`).join("");
}
function populateRefDoctypeDropdowns(){
  const opts = state.refDoctypes.map(d=>`<option value="${escHtml(d.doctype)}">${escHtml(d.doctype)} (${d.feature_count})</option>`).join("");
  document.getElementById("qRefDoctype").innerHTML = '<option value="">Any</option>' + opts;
  document.getElementById("nfRefDoctype").innerHTML = '<option value="">— No reference (standalone) —</option>' +
    state.refDoctypes.map(d=>`<option value="${escHtml(d.doctype)}">${escHtml(d.doctype)}</option>`).join("");
  document.getElementById("impRefDoctype").innerHTML = '<option value="">— None —</option>' +
    state.refDoctypes.map(d=>`<option value="${escHtml(d.doctype)}">${escHtml(d.doctype)}</option>`).join("");
}
function populateLayerDropdownAndRows(){
  document.getElementById("qLayer").innerHTML = '<option value="">Any</option>' +
    state.layerMeta.map(l=>`<option value="${escHtml(l.layer_name)}">${escHtml(l.layer_name)}</option>`).join("");

  // Source module: free text field on the doctype, no dedicated list API - the
  // distinct values actually in use come off list_features (state.metaByName).
  const modules = new Set();
  Object.values(state.metaByName).forEach(r=>{ if(r.source_module) modules.add(r.source_module); });
  const sourceSel = document.getElementById("qSourceModule");
  const curSource = sourceSel.value;
  sourceSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Any</option>' + Array.from(modules).sort().map(m=>`<option value="${escHtml(m)}">${escHtml(m)}</option>`).join("");
  sourceSel.value = curSource && modules.has(curSource) ? curSource : "";

  const counts = {};
  state.masterFC.features.forEach(f=>{
    const l = (f.properties && f.properties._layer) || "Uncategorized";
    counts[l] = (counts[l]||0) + 1;
  });

  const rows = state.layerMeta.map(l=>{
    const color = safeColor(l.color) || colorForLayer(l.layer_name);
    const n = counts[l.layer_name] || 0;
    const checked = state.layerVisible[l.layer_name] !== false;
    return `<div class="layer-row">
      <input type="checkbox" data-layer="${escHtml(l.layer_name)}" ${checked?"checked":""}>
      <span class="layer-swatch" style="background:${color}"></span>
      <span class="layer-name" title="${escHtml(l.layer_name)}">${escHtml(l.layer_name)}</span>
      <span class="layer-count">${n}</span>
      <button class="attr-table-btn" data-layer="${escHtml(l.layer_name)}" title="Attribute table"><i class="fa-solid fa-table"></i></button>
      <button class="attr-table-btn" data-layer="${escHtml(l.layer_name)}" data-props="1" title="Layer properties"><i class="fa-solid fa-sliders"></i></button>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
  document.getElementById("layerRows").innerHTML = rows || '<div class="empty-note">No layers yet.</div>';
  document.querySelectorAll('#layerRows .attr-table-btn:not([data-props])').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener("click", (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); openAttributeTable(btn.dataset.layer); });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#layerRows .attr-table-btn[data-props]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener("click", (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); openLayerProperties(btn.dataset.layer); });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#layerRows input[type=checkbox]').forEach(cb=>{
    cb.addEventListener("change", ()=>{
      state.layerVisible[cb.dataset.layer] = cb.checked;
      renderMap();
      // Layout Designer is a docked panel, not a takeover - if it's open
      // while you're unchecking layers to prepare a print, reflect that
      // live instead of making you remember to hit "Refresh map".
      if(!document.getElementById("layoutOverlay").classList.contains("hidden")) refreshLayoutPreview(true);
      refreshOpenAttrTabs();
    });
  });
}

// ─────────────────────────────  Rendering  ─────────────────────────────
function filteredFeatures(){
  const f = state.filters;
  let feats = state.masterFC.features.filter(feat=>{
    const p = feat.properties || {};
    const layer = p._layer || "Uncategorized";
    if(state.layerVisible[layer] === false) return false;
    if(f.title && !String(p._title||"").toLowerCase().includes(f.title.toLowerCase())) return false;
    if(f.refDoctype && p._reference_doctype !== f.refDoctype) return false;
    if(f.geomType && feat.geometry && feat.geometry.type !== f.geomType) return false;
    if(f.layer && layer !== f.layer) return false;
    if(f.sourceModule){
      const meta = state.metaByName[p._spatial_feature_name];
      if(!meta || meta.source_module !== f.sourceModule) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
  if(f.bbox && state.map){
    const b = state.map.getBounds();
    feats = feats.filter(feat=>{
      try{
        const pt = turf.pointOnFeature(feat);
        const c = pt.geometry.coordinates;
        return b.contains(L.latLng(c[1], c[0]));
      }catch(e){ return true; }
    });
  }
  return feats;
}

function pinIcon(color, iconClass){
  // color/iconClass ultimately trace back to Spatial Entity Config's
  // color/marker_icon fields (admin-controlled, but not validated at the
  // doctype level) - validate before trusting them in this innerHTML-built
  // style/class attribute string, same reasoning as safeColor/safeIconSlug
  // above.
  const safeC = safeColor(color) || "#185FA5";
  const safeI = safeIconSlug(iconClass) || "fa-map-pin";
  return L.divIcon({
    className:"ss-divicon",
    html:`<div class="ss-pin" style="background:${safeC}"><i class="fa-solid ${safeI}"></i></div>`,
    iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,22], popupAnchor:[0,-20]
  });
}

// ───────────────────────── Label style settings ─────────────────────────
// Live-appliable via CSS custom properties on #spatial-root - changing a
// setting restyles every already-rendered tooltip instantly with zero
// re-render, since the browser recomputes var() on the next paint. Style
// variants (Boxed/Halo/Plain) are separate rules gated by a class instead
// of trying to cram three different background/shadow strategies into one
// parametrized rule.
const DEFAULT_LABEL_SETTINGS = {fontSize:10.5, bold:true, italic:false, color:"#2a2a26", style:"boxed", bgColor:"#ffffff", bgOpacity:0.9, haloColor:"#ffffff"};
let labelSettings = {...DEFAULT_LABEL_SETTINGS};

function hexToRgba(hex, alpha){
  const r = parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16), g = parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16), b = parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16);
  return `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${alpha})`;
}

function applyLabelStyle(s){
  const root = document.getElementById("spatial-root");
  root.style.setProperty("--label-font-size", s.fontSize+"px");
  root.style.setProperty("--label-font-weight", s.bold ? "700" : "400");
  root.style.setProperty("--label-font-style", s.italic ? "italic" : "normal");
  root.style.setProperty("--label-color", s.color);
  root.classList.remove("label-style-halo", "label-style-plain");
  if(s.style === "halo"){
    root.classList.add("label-style-halo");
    const hc = s.haloColor;
    root.style.setProperty("--label-halo-shadow", `-1px -1px 0 ${hc},1px -1px 0 ${hc},-1px 1px 0 ${hc},1px 1px 0 ${hc},0 0 3px ${hc}`);
  } else if(s.style === "plain"){
    root.classList.add("label-style-plain");
  } else {
    root.style.setProperty("--label-bg", hexToRgba(s.bgColor, s.bgOpacity));
  }
}

            <option value="halo" ${labelSettings.style==="halo"?"selected":""}>Halo (outlined text, no box)</option>

          </select></div>
          <div class="field" id="lsBgColorField" style="flex:1 1 160px"><label>Background Color</label><input type="color" id="lsBgColor" value="${labelSettings.bgColor}" style="width:100%;height:32px;padding:2px;border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--radius-sm)"></div>

      </div>
    </div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(scrim);

  function readForm(){

  scrim.querySelector(".modal-body").addEventListener("input", readForm);

function renderMap(){
  if(state.geoLayer){ state.map.removeLayer(state.geoLayer); }
  state.featureLayerByName = {};
  const feats = filteredFeatures();

  state.geoLayer = L.geoJSON({type:"FeatureCollection", features:feats}, {
    pointToLayer:(feature, latlng)=>{
      const color = featureColor(feature);
      const iconClass = feature.properties.marker_icon ? ("fa-"+feature.properties.marker_icon) : "fa-map-pin";
      return L.marker(latlng, {icon: pinIcon(color, iconClass)});
    },
    style:(feature)=>({
      color: featureColor(feature), weight: featureWeight(feature),
      fillColor: featureColor(feature), fillOpacity: featureFillOpacity(feature), opacity: .9
    }),
    onEachFeature:(feature, layer)=>{
      const name = feature.properties._spatial_feature_name;
      state.featureLayerByName[name] = layer;
      const title = feature.properties._title || name;
      layer.bindPopup(`<div class="ss-pop-t">${escHtml(title)}</div><div class="ss-pop-s">${escHtml(feature.properties._layer||"—")} · ${escHtml(feature.geometry.type)}</div>`);
      layer.on("click", ()=>{ selectFeature(name); });
      // Persistent on-map labels - this is what actually tells two overlapping
      // Farm Boundary polygons (same color, same layer) apart at a glance,
      // instead of needing to click each one to see its popup.
      if(state.showLabels && feature.properties._title){
        const isPoint = feature.geometry.type==="Point" || feature.geometry.type==="MultiPoint";
        layer.bindTooltip(feature.properties._title, {
          permanent: true, className: "feature-label",
          direction: isPoint ? "right" : "center",
          offset: isPoint ? [10,0] : [0,0],
        });
      }
    }
  }).addTo(state.map);

  document.getElementById("qResultCount").textContent = "("+feats.length+")";
  renderQueryResults(feats);
}

function renderQueryResults(feats){
  const box = document.getElementById("qResults");
  const anyFilter = state.filters.title || state.filters.refDoctype || state.filters.geomType || state.filters.layer || state.filters.sourceModule || state.filters.bbox;
  if(!anyFilter){
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">Set a filter or search above to list matching features.</div>';
    return;
  }
  if(!feats.length){ box.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">No features match.</div>'; return; }
  box.innerHTML = feats.map(f=>{
    const name = f.properties._spatial_feature_name;
    const sel = name === state.selectedName ? " sel" : "";
    return `<div class="result-row${sel}" data-name="${escHtml(name)}">
      <div class="result-title">${escHtml(f.properties._title || name)}</div>
      <div class="result-meta"><span class="badge b-blue">${escHtml(f.properties._layer||"—")}</span>${escHtml(f.geometry.type)}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
  box.querySelectorAll(".result-row").forEach(row=>{
    row.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      const name = row.dataset.name;
      const layer = state.featureLayerByName[name];
      if(layer){
        if(layer.getBounds) state.map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds(), {maxZoom:17});
        else if(layer.getLatLng) state.map.setView(layer.getLatLng(), 17);
      }
      selectFeature(name);
    });
  });
}

// ─────────────────────────────  Feature detail / edit / delete  ─────────────────────────────
async function selectFeature(name){
  state.selectedName = name;
  openPanel("panelDetail");
  document.getElementById("detailBody").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">Loading…</div>';
  try{
    const d = await callMethod(API+"get_feature", {name:name});
    state.selectedDetail = d;
    renderDetail(d);
    updateProcessHints(d);
    Object.values(state.featureLayerByName).forEach(l=>{ if(l.setIcon) return; });
  }catch(e){
    document.getElementById("detailBody").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">Could not load feature: '+escHtml(e.message)+'</div>';
  }
}

function renderDetail(d){
  const refLink = (d.reference_doctype && d.reference_name)
    ? (d.reference_doctype === "Asset"
        ? `<span title="Linked to an Asset record — identity withheld here">${escHtml(d.reference_doctype)}</span>`
        : `<a href="/app/${encodeURIComponent(d.reference_doctype.toLowerCase().replace(/ /g,"-"))}/${encodeURIComponent(d.reference_name)}" target="_blank">${escHtml(d.reference_doctype)} · ${escHtml(d.reference_name)}</a>`)
    : "—";
  const sizeRow = d.geometry_type && d.geometry_type.includes("Polygon")
    ? `<div class="kv-row"><span class="kv-l">Area</span><span class="kv-v">${fmtNum(d.area_sq_m,1)} m²</span></div>`
    : (d.geometry_type && d.geometry_type.includes("Line")
      ? `<div class="kv-row"><span class="kv-l">Length</span><span class="kv-v">${fmtNum(d.length_m,1)} m</span></div>`
      : "");
  let propsHtml = '<div class="hint">None</div>';
  if(d.properties && Object.keys(d.properties).length){
    propsHtml = '<table class="props-table">' + Object.entries(d.properties).map(([k,v])=>
      `<tr><td>${escHtml(k)}</td><td>${escHtml(typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : v)}</td></tr>`).join("") + '</table>';
  }
  document.getElementById("detailBody").innerHTML = `
    <div class="kv-row"><span class="kv-l">Title</span><span class="kv-v">${escHtml(d.title || d.name)}</span></div>
    <div class="kv-row"><span class="kv-l">Layer</span><span class="kv-v"><span class="badge b-blue">${escHtml(d.name && state.masterFC ? (findLayerFor(d.name)||"—") : "—")}</span></span></div>
    <div class="kv-row"><span class="kv-l">Geometry</span><span class="kv-v">${escHtml(d.geometry_type||"—")}</span></div>
    ${sizeRow}
    <div class="kv-row"><span class="kv-l">Farm</span><span class="kv-v">${escHtml(d.farm||"—")}</span></div>
    <div class="kv-row"><span class="kv-l">Reference</span><span class="kv-v">${refLink}</span></div>
    <div class="kv-row"><span class="kv-l">Role</span><span class="kv-v">${escHtml(d.feature_role||"—")}</span></div>
    <div class="kv-row"><span class="kv-l">Source</span><span class="kv-v">${escHtml(d.source_module||"—")}</span></div>

    <div class="section-label">Properties</div>
    ${propsHtml}

// ─────────────────────────────  Geometry edit  ─────────────────────────────
function startEditFeature(d){
  const layer = state.featureLayerByName[d.name];
  if(!layer){ toast("That feature isn't currently drawn on the map (hidden layer or filtered out).", true); return; }
  state.editMeta = {reference_doctype:d.reference_doctype, reference_name:d.reference_name, feature_role:d.feature_role, farm:d.farm, title:d.title, name:d.name};
  state.editGroup = new L.FeatureGroup();
  state.editGroup.addLayer(layer);
  state.map.addLayer(state.editGroup);
  state.editHandler = new L.EditToolbar.Edit(state.map, {featureGroup: state.editGroup});
  state.editHandler.enable();
  document.getElementById("editBar").classList.add("show");
}
function stopEditFeature(discard){
  // L.EditToolbar.Edit.disable() reverts any uncommitted drag/reshape back
  // to the original geometry when .save() hasn't been called first - so
  // this alone is already enough to discard in-progress edits on cancel.
  if(state.editHandler){ state.editHandler.disable(); }
  if(state.editGroup){ state.map.removeLayer(state.editGroup); }
  document.getElementById("editBar").classList.remove("show");
  state.editHandler = null; state.editGroup = null;
  if(discard){
    // Cancel path: nothing changed server-side, so a full loadAll() isn't
    // needed - but editGroup held the SAME layer object state.geoLayer
    // still tracks as one of its own children (not a copy). Removing
    // editGroup from the map just above also detaches that shared layer
    // from the map's DOM/registry, even though state.geoLayer's own
    // bookkeeping still thinks it's present - leaving the feature visually
    // gone until something else happens to trigger a re-render. A local
    // renderMap() (cheap - just rebuilds from the already-loaded masterFC,
    // no network round-trip) puts it back correctly. The Save path below
    // doesn't need this: it calls loadAll() itself right after, which is a
    // superset of what renderMap() alone would do here.
    renderMap();
  }
}
async function saveEditFeature(){
  if(!state.editGroup || !state.editMeta) return;
  const layers = state.editGroup.getLayers();
  if(!layers.length) return;
  const geojson = layers[0].toGeoJSON();
  const meta = state.editMeta;
  try{
    await callMethod(API+"upsert_feature", {
      geometry: JSON.stringify(geojson.geometry),
      name: meta.name,
      reference_doctype: meta.reference_doctype, reference_name: meta.reference_name,
      feature_role: meta.feature_role, farm: meta.farm, title: meta.title
    });
    toast("Geometry updated.");
    stopEditFeature(false);
    await loadAll(document.getElementById("farmFilter").value || undefined);
    selectFeature(meta.name);
  }catch(e){
    toast("Save failed: "+e.message, true);
  }
}

let pendingDrawLayer = null, pendingDrawGeomType = null;
function setDrawMode(mode){
  if(state.drawHandler){ state.drawHandler.disable(); state.drawHandler = null; }
  document.querySelectorAll(".draw-opt").forEach(o=>o.classList.remove("active"));
  if(!mode){ state.drawMode = null; return; }
  const opts = {shapeOptions:{color:"#185FA5", weight:3}};
  let Handler;
  if(mode === "marker") Handler = L.Draw.Marker;
  else if(mode === "polyline") Handler = L.Draw.Polyline;
  else if(mode === "polygon") Handler = L.Draw.Polygon;
  else if(mode === "rectangle") Handler = L.Draw.Rectangle;
  if(!Handler) return;
  state.drawHandler = new Handler(state.map, mode==="marker" ? undefined : opts);
  state.drawHandler.enable();
  state.drawMode = mode;
  const el = document.querySelector('.draw-opt[data-mode="'+mode+'"]');
  if(el) el.classList.add("active");
}
function onDrawCreated(e){
  pendingDrawLayer = e.layer;
  pendingDrawGeomType = e.layerType;

// ─────────────────────────────  Export  ─────────────────────────────
// A deliberate dialog rather than an instant one-click download - which
// layers and which format shouldn't depend on whatever the sidebar/Query
// tab happen to be set to at the moment (easy to forget a leftover title
// filter from earlier and silently under-export). Uses state.masterFC
// directly (every loaded feature) rather than filteredFeatures(), since
// layer choice here is now explicit, not inherited from ambient UI state.
const EXPORT_FORMAT_HINTS = {
  geojson: "Every geometry type, all properties preserved.",
  kml: "Every geometry type. Properties are flattened into each placemark's description.",
  gpx: "Points become waypoints, lines become tracks. Polygons aren't representable in GPX and are skipped.",
  csv: "Points only (as lat/lon columns + properties). Lines and polygons are skipped.",
};

function openExportModal(){
  const rows = document.getElementById("expLayerRows");
  rows.innerHTML = state.layerMeta.map(l=>{
    const color = safeColor(l.color) || colorForLayer(l.layer_name);
    const checked = state.layerVisible[l.layer_name] !== false; // pre-checked to match what's currently visible on the map
    return `<label class="check-row">
      <input type="checkbox" class="exp-layer-cb" value="${escHtml(l.layer_name)}" ${checked?"checked":""}>
      <span class="layer-swatch" style="background:${color}"></span>${escHtml(l.layer_name)}
    </label>`;
  }).join("") || '<div class="empty-note">No layers to export.</div>';
  document.getElementById("expResult").innerHTML = "";
  updateExportFormatHint();
  document.getElementById("exportScrim").classList.add("show");
}
function closeExportModal(){ document.getElementById("exportScrim").classList.remove("show"); }
function updateExportFormatHint(){
  document.getElementById("expFormatHint").textContent = EXPORT_FORMAT_HINTS[document.getElementById("expFormat").value] || "";
}
function downloadBlob(content, mime, filename){
  const blob = new Blob([content], {type: mime});
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url; a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
function csvFromFeatures(feats){
  const points = feats.filter(f=>f.geometry && f.geometry.type==="Point");
  const propKeys = new Set();
  points.forEach(f=>Object.keys(f.properties||{}).forEach(k=>{ if(!k.startsWith("_")) propKeys.add(k); }));
  const headers = ["title","lat","lon", ...Array.from(propKeys)];
  const escCsv = v => {
    const s = v==null ? "" : String(v);
    return /[",\n]/.test(s) ? '"'+s.replace(/"/g,'""')+'"' : s;
  };
  const lines = [headers.map(escCsv).join(",")];
  points.forEach(f=>{
    const p = f.properties||{};
    const row = [p._title||p._spatial_feature_name||"", f.geometry.coordinates[1], f.geometry.coordinates[0], ...Array.from(propKeys).map(k=>p[k])];
    lines.push(row.map(escCsv).join(","));
  });
  return {text: lines.join("\n"), skipped: feats.length - points.length};
}
async function runExport(){
  const btn = document.getElementById("exportRunBtn");
  const resultEl = document.getElementById("expResult");
  const checkedLayers = new Set(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".exp-layer-cb:checked")).map(cb=>cb.value));
  if(!checkedLayers.size){ resultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="import-fail">Pick at least one layer.</div>'; return; }

  const feats = state.masterFC.features.filter(f=>checkedLayers.has(f.properties._layer||"Uncategorized"));
  if(!feats.length){ resultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="import-fail">No features in the selected layer(s).</div>'; return; }

  btn.disabled = true;
  try{
    const format = document.getElementById("expFormat").value;
    const filename = "map-viewer-export-"+todayISO();
    const fc = {type:"FeatureCollection", features: feats};

    if(format === "geojson"){
      downloadBlob(JSON.stringify(fc, null, 2), "application/geo+json", filename+".geojson");
      resultEl.innerHTML = `<div class="import-summary">Exported <b>${feats.length}</b> feature(s).</div>`;
    } else if(format === "kml"){
      downloadBlob(tokml(fc), "application/vnd.google-earth.kml+xml", filename+".kml");
      resultEl.innerHTML = `<div class="import-summary">Exported <b>${feats.length}</b> feature(s).</div>`;
    } else if(format === "gpx"){
      const supported = feats.filter(f=>f.geometry && (f.geometry.type==="Point" || f.geometry.type==="LineString" || f.geometry.type==="MultiLineString"));
      downloadBlob(togpx({type:"FeatureCollection", features: supported}), "application/gpx+xml", filename+".gpx");
      const skipped = feats.length - supported.length;
      resultEl.innerHTML = `<div class="import-summary">Exported <b>${supported.length}</b> feature(s)${skipped?`, <b>${skipped}</b> polygon(s) skipped (not representable in GPX)`:""}.</div>`;
    } else if(format === "csv"){
      const {text, skipped} = csvFromFeatures(feats);
      downloadBlob(text, "text/csv", filename+".csv");
      resultEl.innerHTML = `<div class="import-summary">Exported <b>${feats.length-skipped}</b> point(s)${skipped?`, <b>${skipped}</b> non-point feature(s) skipped`:""}.</div>`;
    }
    toast("Export complete.");
  }catch(e){
    resultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="import-fail">Export failed: '+escHtml(e.message)+'</div>';
  }finally{
    btn.disabled = false;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────  Attribute Table  ─────────────────────────────
// Every feature in a layer, no filter required first (unlike the Query tab's
// results list, which is deliberately empty until a filter is set) - the
// standard GIS "right-click a layer -> Open Attribute Table" workflow.
// Opens as its own closable tab next to Map/Layout (ArcGIS Pro's own
// pattern) rather than a modal - one tab per layer, re-used on repeat opens.
function openAttributeTable(layerName){
  const viewId = "attr:"+layerName;
  const isNew = !document.querySelector(`.canvas-view[data-view="${viewId}"]`);
  findOrCreateViewTab(viewId, layerName, "fa-table", true);
  if(isNew){
    const overlay = document.createElement("div");
    overlay.className = "canvas-view hidden";
    overlay.dataset.view = viewId;
    overlay.dataset.layer = layerName;
    overlay.innerHTML = `
      <div class="layout-toolbar">
        <input type="text" class="attr-tab-search" placeholder="Search title or farm…" style="flex:0 1 280px">
        <span class="hint attr-tab-count" style="margin-left:auto"></span>
      </div>
      <div style="overflow:auto;flex:1">
        <table class="attr-table">
          <thead><tr><th>Title</th><th>Geometry</th><th>Farm</th><th>Role</th><th>Area / Length</th><th>Source</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody class="attr-tab-body"></tbody>
        </table>
      </div>`;
    document.querySelector(".ss-canvas").appendChild(overlay);
    overlay.querySelector(".attr-tab-search").addEventListener("input", (e)=>renderAttrTabRows(overlay, e.target.value));
  }
  renderAttrTabRows(document.querySelector(`.canvas-view[data-view="${viewId}"]`), "");
  switchView(viewId);
}
function renderAttrTabRows(overlay, query){
  const layerName = overlay.dataset.layer;
  const q = (query||"").toLowerCase();
  const feats = state.masterFC.features.filter(f=>{
    if((f.properties._layer||"Uncategorized") !== layerName) return false;
    if(!q) return true;
    const p = f.properties||{};
    return String(p._title||"").toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(p._farm||"").toLowerCase().includes(q);
  });
  const body = overlay.querySelector(".attr-tab-body");
  body.innerHTML = feats.map(f=>{
    const p = f.properties||{};
    const meta = state.metaByName[p._spatial_feature_name] || {};
    const sizeVal = f.geometry.type.includes("Polygon") ? (meta.area_sq_m!=null?fmtNum(meta.area_sq_m,0)+" m²":"—")
      : f.geometry.type.includes("Line") ? (meta.length_m!=null?fmtNum(meta.length_m,0)+" m":"—") : "—";
    return `<tr data-name="${escHtml(p._spatial_feature_name)}">
      <td>${escHtml(p._title||p._spatial_feature_name)}</td>
      <td>${escHtml(f.geometry.type)}</td>
      <td>${escHtml(p._farm||"—")}</td>
      <td>${escHtml(meta.feature_role||"—")}</td>
      <td>${sizeVal}</td>
      <td>${escHtml(meta.source_module||"—")}</td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join("");
  overlay.querySelector(".attr-tab-count").textContent = feats.length+" feature(s)";
  body.querySelectorAll("tr").forEach(row=>{
    row.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      const name = row.dataset.name;
      switchView("map");
      selectFeature(name);
      const layer = state.featureLayerByName[name];
      if(layer){
        if(layer.getBounds) state.map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds(), {maxZoom:17});
        else if(layer.getLatLng) state.map.setView(layer.getLatLng(), Math.max(state.map.getZoom(),15));
      }
    });
  });
}
// Any Attribute Table tab currently open (not just the active one) should
// stay in sync with the map's data - cheap enough to just re-render all of
// them whenever the feature set changes, rather than tracking staleness.
function refreshOpenAttrTabs(){
  document.querySelectorAll(".canvas-view[data-layer]").forEach(overlay=>{
    renderAttrTabRows(overlay, overlay.querySelector(".attr-tab-search").value);
  });
}

// Fires on every input change (dragging the opacity slider, typing a color,
// nudging the width) - updates the map immediately, before Save is ever
// clicked, matching how a real GIS symbology dialog previews live.
function previewLayerProperties(){
  if(!layerPropsCurrent) return;

function closeLayerProperties(){

async function saveLayerProperties(){

// ─────────────────────────────  Import → Layout handoff  ─────────────────────────────
let importHighlightLayer = null;
function highlightImportedFeatures(feats){
  if(importHighlightLayer){ state.map.removeLayer(importHighlightLayer); importHighlightLayer = null; }
  if(!feats.length) return;
  importHighlightLayer = L.geoJSON({type:"FeatureCollection", features: feats}, {
    style: {color:"#185FA5", weight:3, dashArray:"6,4", fillOpacity:.08},
    pointToLayer: (f, latlng)=>L.circleMarker(latlng, {radius:9, color:"#185FA5", weight:3, fillOpacity:.15}),
  }).addTo(state.map);
  // Auto-clears - this is a "just imported" callout, not a permanent style,
  // and leaving it forever would be confusing once the moment's passed.
  setTimeout(()=>{ if(importHighlightLayer){ state.map.removeLayer(importHighlightLayer); importHighlightLayer = null; } }, 20000);
}
function prepareLayoutFromImport(){
  const feats = state.masterFC.features.filter(f=>lastImportedNames.includes(f.properties._spatial_feature_name));
  if(!feats.length){
    toast("Imported features aren't visible on the map right now — check the layer/farm filters aren't hiding them.", true);
    return;
  }
  closeImportModal();
  const bounds = L.geoJSON({type:"FeatureCollection", features: feats}).getBounds();
  // animate:false - switchView("layout") captures the map immediately after
  // this; an animated fitBounds would still be mid-pan when that capture
  // runs, showing the wrong (transitional) view.
  if(bounds.isValid()) state.map.fitBounds(bounds, {padding:[40,40], maxZoom:17, animate:false});
  highlightImportedFeatures(feats);
  switchView("layout");
}
async function handleImportFile(e){
  const file = e.target.files[0];
  if(!file) return;
  const preview = document.getElementById("importPreview");
  const runBtn = document.getElementById("importRunBtn");
  state.importParsed = null;
  runBtn.disabled = true;
  preview.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-note">Reading file…</div>';
  try{
    const fc = await parseImportFile(file);
    const feats = fc.features || [];
    if(!feats.length) throw new Error("No features found in file.");
    const types = {};
    feats.forEach(f=>{ const t = f.geometry && f.geometry.type; if(t) types[t] = (types[t]||0)+1; });
    state.importParsed = fc;
    preview.innerHTML = `<div class="import-summary">
      <b>${feats.length}</b> feature(s) found · ${Object.entries(types).map(([t,n])=>`${escHtml(t)}: ${n}`).join(", ") || "no geometry types found"}
    </div>`;
    runBtn.disabled = false;
  }catch(err){
    preview.innerHTML = '<div class="import-fail">Could not parse file: '+escHtml(err.message)+'</div>';
    runBtn.disabled = true;
    state.importParsed = null;
  }
}

// Every branch below normalizes to a plain {type:"FeatureCollection", features:[...]}
// so runImport() and the backend's import_features() need no format awareness at all.
async function parseImportFile(file){
  const name = file.name.toLowerCase();
  const ext = name.includes(".") ? name.slice(name.lastIndexOf(".")+1) : "";

  if(ext === "json" || ext === "geojson"){
    return normalizeGeoJSON(JSON.parse(await file.text()));
  }
  if(ext === "kml"){
    return toGeoJSON.kml(parseXml(await file.text()));
  }
  if(ext === "gpx"){
    return toGeoJSON.gpx(parseXml(await file.text()));
  }
  if(ext === "kmz"){
    const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(await file.arrayBuffer());
    const entry = Object.values(zip.files).find(f=>!f.dir && f.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".kml"));
    if(!entry) throw new Error("No .kml file found inside the .kmz archive.");
    return toGeoJSON.kml(parseXml(await entry.async("text")));
  }
  if(ext === "zip"){
    // shpjs reads the .shp/.dbf/.prj set from the zip and reprojects to
    // WGS84 automatically when a .prj is present - this is why a zipped
    // shapefile is recommended over a lone .shp (no attributes/projection).
    const result = await shp(await file.arrayBuffer());
    const collections = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];
    return {type:"FeatureCollection", features: collections.flatMap(c=>c.features || [])};
  }
  if(ext === "shp"){
    // Geometry only - no .dbf means no attributes, no .prj means no
    // reprojection (coordinates are assumed to already be WGS84 lat/lon).
    const geometries = shp.parseShp(await file.arrayBuffer());
    return {type:"FeatureCollection", features: geometries.map(geometry=>({type:"Feature", geometry, properties:{}}))};
  }
  if(ext === "csv"){
    return csvToGeoJSON(await file.text());
  }
  throw new Error("Unsupported file type: ."+(ext||"unknown")+". Supported: .geojson, .json, .kml, .kmz, .gpx, .zip (shapefile), .csv");
}

function normalizeGeoJSON(parsed){
  let feats;
  if(parsed.type === "FeatureCollection") feats = parsed.features || [];
  else if(parsed.type === "Feature") feats = [parsed];
  else if(Array.isArray(parsed)) feats = parsed;
  else throw new Error("Not a recognizable GeoJSON Feature/FeatureCollection/list.");
  return {type:"FeatureCollection", features: feats};
}

function parseXml(text){
  const xml = new DOMParser().parseFromString(text, "text/xml");
  if(xml.querySelector("parsererror")) throw new Error("Could not parse XML file.");
  return xml;
}

function csvToGeoJSON(text){
  const lines = text.split(/\r\n|\n|\r/).filter(l=>l.trim().length);
  if(lines.length < 2) throw new Error("CSV needs a header row and at least one data row.");
  const headers = splitCsvLine(lines[0]).map(h=>h.trim());
  const lower = headers.map(h=>h.toLowerCase());
  const latIdx = lower.findIndex(h=>["lat","latitude","y"].includes(h));
  const lonIdx = lower.findIndex(h=>["lon","lng","long","longitude","x"].includes(h));
  if(latIdx === -1 || lonIdx === -1) throw new Error("CSV must have latitude/longitude columns (lat/lon, latitude/longitude, or x/y).");
  const features = [];
  for(let i=1;i<lines.length;i++){
    const cells = splitCsvLine(lines[i]);
    if(!cells.length) continue;
    const lat = parseFloat(cells[latIdx]);
    const lon = parseFloat(cells[lonIdx]);
    if(!isFinite(lat) || !isFinite(lon)) continue;
    const properties = {};
    headers.forEach((h,idx)=>{ if(idx!==latIdx && idx!==lonIdx) properties[h] = cells[idx]; });
    features.push({type:"Feature", geometry:{type:"Point", coordinates:[lon, lat]}, properties});
  }
  if(!features.length) throw new Error("No valid rows with numeric lat/lon found.");
  return {type:"FeatureCollection", features};
}

function splitCsvLine(line){
  // Minimal CSV split that still honors quoted fields containing commas.
  const out = [];
  let cur = "", inQuotes = false;
  for(let i=0;i<line.length;i++){
    const c = line[i];
    if(inQuotes){
      if(c === '"'){ if(line[i+1] === '"'){ cur+='"'; i++; } else inQuotes = false; }
      else cur += c;
    } else if(c === '"') inQuotes = true;
    else if(c === ","){ out.push(cur); cur=""; }
    else cur += c;
  }
  out.push(cur);
  return out;
}
let lastImportedNames = [];
async function runImport(){

}

// ─────────────────────────────  Layout / Export (PNG / JPG / PDF)  ─────────────────────────────
// Rasterizes the live map (tiles + vector overlays) via leaflet-image, then
// draws title/legend/scale-bar/north-arrow straight onto that canvas with
// plain Canvas 2D calls - no separate "print composer" DOM to keep in sync
// with the real map, what you see on screen is what gets captured.
function drawNorthArrow(ctx, x, y, size){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0a0a";
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -size);
  ctx.lineTo(size*0.35, size*0.5);
  ctx.lineTo(0, size*0.2);
  ctx.lineTo(-size*0.35, size*0.5);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0a0a";
  ctx.font = "bold 13px sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText("N", 0, -size-6);
  ctx.restore();
}
function niceScaleDistance(maxMeters){
  // Same "round down to 1/2/5 x 10^n" convention Leaflet's own L.control.scale uses.
  const pow10 = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(maxMeters)));
  let nice = pow10;
  [1,2,5,10].forEach(m=>{ if(m*pow10 <= maxMeters) nice = m*pow10; });
  return nice;
}
function drawScaleBar(ctx, map, x, y, maxBarPx){
  const p1 = map.containerPointToLatLng([0, map.getSize().y]);
  const p2 = map.containerPointToLatLng([maxBarPx, map.getSize().y]);
  const maxMeters = map.distance(p1, p2);
  if(!maxMeters || !isFinite(maxMeters)) return;
  const dist = niceScaleDistance(maxMeters);
  const label = dist >= 1000 ? fmtNum(dist/1000,1)+" km" : fmtNum(dist,0)+" m";
  const barPx = maxBarPx * (dist / maxMeters);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#0a0a0a";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0a0a";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, 0); ctx.lineTo(barPx, 0);
  ctx.moveTo(0, -5); ctx.lineTo(0, 5);
  ctx.moveTo(barPx, -5); ctx.lineTo(barPx, 5);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.font = "12px sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillText(label, barPx/2, -8);
  ctx.restore();
}
function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w, y, x+w, y+h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w, y+h, x, y+h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y+h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x+w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function drawLegend(ctx, x, y, boxW){
  const visible = state.layerMeta.filter(l => state.layerVisible[l.layer_name] !== false);
  if(!visible.length) return;
  const rowH = 18, pad = 10, headH = 22;
  const boxH = pad*2 + headH + rowH*visible.length;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.92)";
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(10,10,10,0.15)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  roundRect(ctx, x, y, boxW, boxH, 8);
  ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0a0a";
  ctx.font = "bold 12px sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("Legend", x+pad, y+pad+10);

  visible.forEach((l, i)=>{
    const ry = y + pad + headH + i*rowH;
    ctx.fillStyle = safeColor(l.color) || "#8a8780";
    ctx.fillRect(x+pad, ry, 12, 12);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(10,10,10,0.2)";
    ctx.strokeRect(x+pad, ry, 12, 12);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2a26";
    ctx.font = "11.5px sans-serif";
    const label = l.layer_name.length > 22 ? l.layer_name.slice(0,21)+"…" : l.layer_name;
    ctx.fillText(label, x+pad+18, ry+10.5);
  });
  ctx.restore();
}

// ─────────────────────────────  Layout Designer  ─────────────────────────────
// A real print-composer page (paper size, grid, neatline), not just an
// export button - opens as a full takeover of this same view (no page
// navigation), the way QGIS/ArcGIS treat a Print Layout as its own window
// rather than a settings popover.
const PAPER_SIZES_MM = {A4:[210,297], A3:[297,420], Letter:[215.9,279.4], Legal:[215.9,355.6]};
const LAYOUT_DPI = 150;
let layoutMapCanvas = null; // cached raw map capture - grid/neatline/legend redraw cheaply against it without re-capturing on every toggle

function layoutPaperPixelSize(){
  const name = document.getElementById("layoutPaperSize").value;
  const orientation = document.getElementById("layoutOrientation").value;
  let [wmm, hmm] = PAPER_SIZES_MM[name];
  if(orientation==="landscape" && hmm>wmm) [wmm,hmm] = [hmm,wmm];
  if(orientation==="portrait" && wmm>hmm) [wmm,hmm] = [hmm,wmm];
  const pxPerMm = LAYOUT_DPI/25.4;
  return {w: Math.round(wmm*pxPerMm), h: Math.round(hmm*pxPerMm)};
}
function captureMapCanvas(){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject)=>{
    leafletImage(state.map, (err, canvas)=> err ? reject(err instanceof Error?err:new Error(String(err))) : resolve(canvas));
  });
}
function niceGridInterval(spanDeg){
  const target = spanDeg/5; // aim for roughly 5 grid lines across the extent
  const pow10 = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(target)));
  let nice = pow10;
  [1,2,5,10].forEach(m=>{ if(m*pow10 <= target) nice = m*pow10; });
  return nice || pow10;
}
function drawLayoutGrid(ctx, map, rect){
  // rect: {x,y,w,h} - where the map image sits on the output page. Grid
  // lines are computed as a FRACTION of the live map's own container size
  // (via latLngToContainerPoint / map.getSize()) then scaled into rect, so
  // this stays aligned regardless of the raw capture's pixel resolution.
  const size = map.getSize();
  const bounds = map.getBounds();
  const south = bounds.getSouth(), north = bounds.getNorth(), west = bounds.getWest(), east = bounds.getEast();
  const latStep = niceGridInterval(north-south), lonStep = niceGridInterval(east-west);
  const toXY = (lat, lon)=>{
    const pt = map.latLngToContainerPoint([lat, lon]);
    return {x: rect.x + (pt.x/size.x)*rect.w, y: rect.y + (pt.y/size.y)*rect.h};
  };

  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.w, rect.h); ctx.clip();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(10,10,10,0.4)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.setLineDash([3,3]);
  ctx.font = "10px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0a0a";

  for(let lon=Math.ceil(west/lonStep)*lonStep; lon<=east; lon+=lonStep){
    const top = toXY(north, lon);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(top.x, rect.y); ctx.lineTo(top.x, rect.y+rect.h); ctx.stroke();
  }
  for(let lat=Math.ceil(south/latStep)*latStep; lat<=north; lat+=latStep){
    const left = toXY(lat, west);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(rect.x, left.y); ctx.lineTo(rect.x+rect.w, left.y); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.restore();

  // Labels drawn outside the clip so they aren't cut off at the map edge
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0a0a";
  ctx.font = "10px sans-serif";
  for(let lon=Math.ceil(west/lonStep)*lonStep; lon<=east; lon+=lonStep){
    const top = toXY(north, lon);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(lon.toFixed(3)+"°", top.x, rect.y-4);
  }
  for(let lat=Math.ceil(south/latStep)*latStep; lat<=north; lat+=latStep){
    const left = toXY(lat, west);
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillText(lat.toFixed(3)+"°", rect.x-4, left.y+3);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawNeatline(ctx, x, y, w, h){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#0a0a0a";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(x, y, w, h);
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.75;
  ctx.strokeRect(x+5, y+5, w-10, h-10);
  ctx.restore();
}
const LAYOUT_LEGEND_POS = {
  br:(pw,ph,bw,bh)=>({x:pw-bw-24, y:ph-bh-24}),
  bl:(pw,ph,bw,bh)=>({x:24, y:ph-bh-24}),
  tr:(pw,ph,bw,bh)=>({x:pw-bw-24, y:24}),
  tl:(pw,ph,bw,bh)=>({x:24, y:24}),
};

async function renderLayoutCanvas(){
  const {w: pageW, h: pageH} = layoutPaperPixelSize();
  const canvas = document.getElementById("layoutCanvas");
  canvas.width = pageW; canvas.height = pageH;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, pageW, pageH);

  const margin = 36;
  const title = document.getElementById("layoutTitle").value.trim();
  const titleBand = title ? 46 : 0;
  const mapRect = {x: margin, y: margin+titleBand, w: pageW-margin*2, h: pageH-margin*2-titleBand-24};

  if(!layoutMapCanvas){
    document.getElementById("layoutStatus").textContent = "Capturing map…";
    layoutMapCanvas = await captureMapCanvas();
  }
  ctx.drawImage(layoutMapCanvas, mapRect.x, mapRect.y, mapRect.w, mapRect.h);

  if(title){
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0a0a";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText(title, margin, margin+30);
  }
  if(document.getElementById("layoutGrid").checked) drawLayoutGrid(ctx, state.map, mapRect);
  if(document.getElementById("layoutNeatline").checked) drawNeatline(ctx, mapRect.x, mapRect.y, mapRect.w, mapRect.h);
  if(document.getElementById("layoutNorth").checked) drawNorthArrow(ctx, mapRect.x+mapRect.w-40, mapRect.y+50, 16);
  if(document.getElementById("layoutScale").checked) drawScaleBar(ctx, state.map, mapRect.x+20, mapRect.y+mapRect.h-16, 120);
  if(document.getElementById("layoutLegend").checked){
    const visible = state.layerMeta.filter(l => state.layerVisible[l.layer_name] !== false);
    const bw = 170, bh = 10*2+22+18*visible.length;
    const pos = LAYOUT_LEGEND_POS[document.getElementById("layoutLegendPos").value](pageW, pageH, bw, bh);
    const x = Math.max(mapRect.x, Math.min(pos.x, mapRect.x+mapRect.w-bw));
    const y = Math.max(mapRect.y, Math.min(pos.y, mapRect.y+mapRect.h-bh));
    drawLegend(ctx, x, y, bw);
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = "#8a8780";
  ctx.font = "9px sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("Map Viewer — Upande Spatial · "+todayISO(), margin, pageH-14);

  document.getElementById("layoutStatus").textContent = "";
}
async function refreshLayoutPreview(recapture){
  if(recapture) layoutMapCanvas = null;
  try{ await renderLayoutCanvas(); }
  catch(e){ document.getElementById("layoutStatus").textContent = "Preview failed: "+e.message; }
}
function switchView(view){
  document.querySelectorAll(".view-tab").forEach(t=>t.classList.toggle("active", t.dataset.view===view));
  document.querySelectorAll(".canvas-view").forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle("hidden", el.dataset.view!==view));

// Finds an existing tab by view id, or creates one and appends it to the
// strip. `closable` gets it an "x" (Map/Layout are permanent; per-layer
// Attribute Table tabs aren't).
function findOrCreateViewTab(viewId, label, icon, closable){
  let tab = document.querySelector(`.view-tab[data-view="${viewId}"]`);
  if(tab) return tab;
  tab = document.createElement("div");
  tab.className = "view-tab";
  tab.dataset.view = viewId;
  tab.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid ${icon}"></i><span>${escHtml(label)}</span>`
    + (closable ? `<button class="view-tab-close"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i></button>` : "");
  tab.addEventListener("click", (e)=>{ if(!e.target.closest(".view-tab-close")) switchView(viewId); });
  if(closable){
    tab.querySelector(".view-tab-close").addEventListener("click", (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); closeViewTab(viewId); });
  }
  document.querySelector(".view-tabs").appendChild(tab);
  return tab;
}
function closeViewTab(viewId){
  const wasActive = document.querySelector(`.view-tab[data-view="${viewId}"]`)?.classList.contains("active");
  document.querySelector(`.view-tab[data-view="${viewId}"]`)?.remove();
  document.querySelector(`.canvas-view[data-view="${viewId}"]`)?.remove();

async function exportLayout(){
  const btn = document.getElementById("layoutExportBtn");
  btn.disabled = true;
  try{
    await renderLayoutCanvas();
    const canvas = document.getElementById("layoutCanvas");
    const format = document.getElementById("layoutFormat").value;
    const filename = "map-viewer-layout-"+todayISO();
    if(format === "pdf"){
      const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
      const orientation = document.getElementById("layoutOrientation").value;
      const doc = new jsPDF({orientation, unit:"mm", format: document.getElementById("layoutPaperSize").value.toLowerCase()});

    } else {

      await new Promise(resolve=>{

// ─────────────────────────────  Geoprocessing (Clip / Union / Merge / Spatial Join)  ─────────────────────────────
// All four work off state.masterFC.features - already-loaded plain GeoJSON
// Features - rather than a server round trip, same reasoning turf-based
// Buffer/Centroid above already use. Clip/Union/Merge save their result the
// same way Buffer/Centroid do: a standalone upsert_feature call (no
// reference_doctype/reference_name given - always creates new, no risk of
// the upsert-by-role collision add_element exists to avoid for EPANET).
function findFeatureByName(name){
  return (state.masterFC.features||[]).find(f=>f.properties && f.properties._spatial_feature_name===name);
}
function populateGeoprocessingDropdowns(){
  const feats = state.masterFC.features || [];

    return `<option value="${escHtml(name)}">${escHtml(label)}</option>`;
  }).join("");
  const anyOpts = optsFor(()=>true);
  const polyOpts = optsFor(f=>f.geometry.type==="Polygon"||f.geometry.type==="MultiPolygon");

  ["gpClipA","gpMergeA","gpMergeB","gpJoinSource"].forEach(id=>{ document.getElementById(id).innerHTML = anyOpts; });

  document.getElementById("gpJoinLayer").innerHTML = state.layerMeta.map(l=>`<option value="${escHtml(l.layer_name)}">${escHtml(l.layer_name)}</option>`).join("");
}

let gpClipSources = [];
function gpClipPreview(){
  const a = findFeatureByName(document.getElementById("gpClipA").value);
  const b = findFeatureByName(document.getElementById("gpClipB").value);
  document.getElementById("gpClipSaveBtn").disabled = true;
  if(!a || !b) return toast("Pick both Feature A and Feature B.", true);
  try{
    let result;
    if(a.geometry.type==="Polygon" || a.geometry.type==="MultiPolygon"){
      result = turf.intersect(a, b);
      if(!result) throw new Error("A and B don't overlap.");
    } else if(a.geometry.type==="Point"){
      if(!turf.booleanPointInPolygon(a, b)) throw new Error("That point doesn't fall inside B.");
      result = a;
    } else if(a.geometry.type==="MultiPoint"){
      const kept = a.geometry.coordinates.filter(c=>turf.booleanPointInPolygon(turf.point(c), b));
      if(!kept.length) throw new Error("No points of A fall inside B.");
      result = kept.length===1 ? turf.point(kept[0]) : turf.multiPoint(kept);
    } else {
      result = turf.bboxClip(a, turf.bbox(b));
    }
    gpShowPreview(result.geometry, "#b3261e");
    gpClipSources = [a.properties._spatial_feature_name, b.properties._spatial_feature_name];
    document.getElementById("gpClipSaveBtn").disabled = false;
  }catch(e){ toast("Clip failed: "+e.message, true); }
}

let gpUnionSources = [];
function gpUnionPreview(){
  const a = findFeatureByName(document.getElementById("gpUnionA").value);
  const b = findFeatureByName(document.getElementById("gpUnionB").value);
  document.getElementById("gpUnionSaveBtn").disabled = true;
  if(!a || !b) return toast("Pick both Feature A and Feature B.", true);
  try{
    const result = turf.union(a, b);
    if(!result) throw new Error("Union produced no result.");
    gpShowPreview(result.geometry, "#185FA5");
    gpUnionSources = [a.properties._spatial_feature_name, b.properties._spatial_feature_name];
    document.getElementById("gpUnionSaveBtn").disabled = false;
  }catch(e){ toast("Union failed: "+e.message, true); }
}

let gpMergeSources = [];
function gpMergePreview(){
  const a = findFeatureByName(document.getElementById("gpMergeA").value);
  const b = findFeatureByName(document.getElementById("gpMergeB").value);
  document.getElementById("gpMergeSaveBtn").disabled = true;
  if(!a || !b) return toast("Pick both Feature A and Feature B.", true);
  const family = t => t.replace("Multi","");
  if(family(a.geometry.type) !== family(b.geometry.type)){
    return toast("Merge needs two features of the same geometry family (both points, both lines, or both polygons).", true);
  }
  try{
    const combined = turf.combine(turf.featureCollection([a, b]));
    const result = combined.features[0];
    gpShowPreview(result.geometry, "#3B6D11");
    gpMergeSources = [a.properties._spatial_feature_name, b.properties._spatial_feature_name];
    document.getElementById("gpMergeSaveBtn").disabled = false;
  }catch(e){ toast("Merge failed: "+e.message, true); }
}

function gpRunJoin(){
  const source = findFeatureByName(document.getElementById("gpJoinSource").value);
  const layer = document.getElementById("gpJoinLayer").value;
  const predicate = document.getElementById("gpJoinPredicate").value;
  const resultEl = document.getElementById("gpJoinResult");
  if(!source || !layer) return toast("Pick a source feature and a target layer.", true);
  const targets = (state.masterFC.features||[]).filter(f=>
    (f.properties._layer||"Uncategorized")===layer && f.properties._spatial_feature_name !== source.properties._spatial_feature_name
  );
  const matches = targets.filter(t=>{
    try{
      if(predicate==="intersects") return turf.booleanIntersects(source, t);
      if(predicate==="within") return turf.booleanWithin(source, t);
      if(predicate==="contains") return turf.booleanContains(source, t);
    }catch(e){ return false; }
    return false;
  });
  resultEl.innerHTML = matches.length
    ? `<div class="import-summary"><b>${matches.length}</b> of ${targets.length} in "${escHtml(layer)}"</div>` +
      matches.map(m=>`<div class="layer-row"><span class="layer-name">${escHtml(m.properties._title||m.properties._spatial_feature_name)}</span></div>`).join("")
    : `<div class="empty-note">No matches among ${targets.length} feature(s) checked.</div>`;
}

let gpHeatLayer = null;

function heatPointsFor(layerName){
  const pts = [];
  state.masterFC.features.forEach(f=>{
    if((f.properties._layer||"Uncategorized") !== layerName) return;
    if(f.geometry.type === "Point") pts.push([f.geometry.coordinates[1], f.geometry.coordinates[0]]);
    else if(f.geometry.type === "MultiPoint") f.geometry.coordinates.forEach(c=>pts.push([c[1], c[0]]));
  });

}
function updateHeatmap(){
  if(gpHeatLayer){ state.map.removeLayer(gpHeatLayer); gpHeatLayer = null; }
  if(!document.getElementById("gpHeatShow").checked) return;
  const layerName = document.getElementById("gpHeatLayer").value;
  if(!layerName){ toast("No point layer selected.", true); document.getElementById("gpHeatShow").checked = false; return; }
  const pts = heatPointsFor(layerName);
  if(!pts.length){ toast("No points found in that layer.", true); document.getElementById("gpHeatShow").checked = false; return; }
  const radius = parseFloat(document.getElementById("gpHeatRadius").value) || 25;
  const blur = parseFloat(document.getElementById("gpHeatBlur").value) || 15;

// ─────────────────────────────  Weighted Overlay  ─────────────────────────────
// A real vector overlay (not a raster one - this app has no raster data
// model at all): geometrically intersects every polygon in Layer A against
// every polygon in Layer B, blends each pair's (score x weight) where they
// overlap, and keeps the correctly-scored leftover of each input that the
// other layer doesn't cover (via turf.difference) - so the output is a
// true partition of the combined area, not just the overlapping slice.
// O(|A| x |B|) turf calls - fine at zone-layer scale (farm blocks, buffer
// zones, ...), not meant for thousands of features per side.
let woPreviewLayer = null;
let woPreviewResults = null;

function polygonLayerNames(){
  const names = new Set();
  state.masterFC.features.forEach(f=>{
    if(f.geometry && (f.geometry.type==="Polygon" || f.geometry.type==="MultiPolygon")){
      names.add(f.properties._layer || "Uncategorized");
    }
  });
  return Array.from(names).sort();
}
function numericPropsForLayer(layerName){
  const keys = new Set();
  state.masterFC.features.forEach(f=>{
    if((f.properties._layer||"Uncategorized") !== layerName) return;
    Object.entries(f.properties||{}).forEach(([k,v])=>{
      if(!k.startsWith("_") && v!=null && v!=="" && isFinite(parseFloat(v))) keys.add(k);
    });
  });
  return Array.from(keys).sort();
}
function populateWeightedOverlayLayers(){
  const names = polygonLayerNames();
  const opts = names.map(n=>`<option value="${escHtml(n)}">${escHtml(n)}</option>`).join("")
    || '<option value="">No polygon layers loaded</option>';
  ["woLayerA","woLayerB"].forEach(id=>{
    const sel = document.getElementById(id);
    const cur = sel.value;
    sel.innerHTML = opts;
    if(names.includes(cur)) sel.value = cur;
  });
  populateWeightedOverlayProps("A");
  populateWeightedOverlayProps("B");
}
function populateWeightedOverlayProps(which){
  const layerName = document.getElementById("woLayer"+which).value;
  const props = layerName ? numericPropsForLayer(layerName) : [];
  const sel = document.getElementById("woProp"+which);
  sel.innerHTML = props.length
    ? props.map(p=>`<option value="${escHtml(p)}">${escHtml(p)}</option>`).join("")
    : '<option value="">No numeric properties found</option>';
}
function scoreForFeature(f, mode, fixedScore, propKey){
  if(mode === "uniform") return fixedScore;
  const v = parseFloat((f.properties||{})[propKey]);
  return isFinite(v) ? v : 0;
}
function woColorForScore(score, min, max){
  if(min===max) return "#854F0B";
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (score-min)/(max-min)));
  const r = Math.round(60 + t*160), g = Math.round(180 - t*160);
  return `rgb(${r},${g},60)`;
}
function runWeightedOverlay(){
  const resultEl = document.getElementById("woResult");
  const layerA = document.getElementById("woLayerA").value, layerB = document.getElementById("woLayerB").value;
  if(!layerA || !layerB || layerA === layerB){
    resultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="import-fail">Pick two different polygon layers.</div>';
    return;
  }
  const weightA = parseFloat(document.getElementById("woWeightA").value) || 0;
  const weightB = parseFloat(document.getElementById("woWeightB").value) || 0;
  const modeA = document.getElementById("woModeA").value, modeB = document.getElementById("woModeB").value;
  const fixedA = parseFloat(document.getElementById("woFixedA").value) || 0;
  const fixedB = parseFloat(document.getElementById("woFixedB").value) || 0;
  const propA = document.getElementById("woPropA").value, propB = document.getElementById("woPropB").value;

  const isPoly = f => f.geometry && (f.geometry.type==="Polygon" || f.geometry.type==="MultiPolygon");
  const featsA = state.masterFC.features.filter(f=>(f.properties._layer||"Uncategorized")===layerA && isPoly(f));
  const featsB = state.masterFC.features.filter(f=>(f.properties._layer||"Uncategorized")===layerB && isPoly(f));
  if(!featsA.length || !featsB.length){
    resultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="import-fail">Both layers need at least one polygon feature.</div>';
    return;
  }

  const outputs = []; // {geometry, score, sources: [names]}
  const safeIntersect = (a,b) => { try{ return turf.intersect(a,b); }catch(e){ return null; } };
  const safeDifference = (a,b) => { try{ return turf.difference(a,b); }catch(e){ return null; } };

  for(const a of featsA){
    let remainingA = a;
    const scoreA = scoreForFeature(a, modeA, fixedA, propA) * weightA;
    for(const b of featsB){
      if(!remainingA) break;
      const inter = safeIntersect(remainingA, b);
      if(inter){
        const scoreB = scoreForFeature(b, modeB, fixedB, propB) * weightB;
        outputs.push({geometry: inter.geometry, score: scoreA+scoreB, sources: [layerA, layerB]});
        remainingA = safeDifference(remainingA, b);
      }
    }
    if(remainingA) outputs.push({geometry: remainingA.geometry, score: scoreA, sources: [layerA]});
  }
  for(const b of featsB){
    let remainingB = b;
    for(const a of featsA){
      if(!remainingB) break;
      remainingB = safeDifference(remainingB, a);
    }
    if(remainingB) outputs.push({geometry: remainingB.geometry, score: scoreForFeature(b, modeB, fixedB, propB)*weightB, sources: [layerB]});
  }

  if(!outputs.length){
    resultEl.innerHTML = '<div class="import-fail">Overlay produced nothing - check the two layers actually have geometry.</div>';
    return;
  }

  const scores = outputs.map(o=>o.score);
  const min = Math.min(...scores), max = Math.max(...scores);
  if(woPreviewLayer) state.map.removeLayer(woPreviewLayer);
  woPreviewLayer = L.geoJSON(outputs.map(o=>({type:"Feature", geometry:o.geometry, properties:{score:o.score}})), {
    style: f => ({color:"#3a3a34", weight:1, fillColor: woColorForScore(f.properties.score, min, max), fillOpacity:.55}),
    onEachFeature: (f,layer) => layer.bindTooltip("Score: "+fmtNum(f.properties.score,2)),
  }).addTo(state.map);

  woPreviewResults = outputs;
  document.getElementById("woSaveBtn").disabled = false;
  resultEl.innerHTML = `<div class="import-summary"><b>${outputs.length}</b> zone(s) · score range ${fmtNum(min,2)} – ${fmtNum(max,2)}</div>`;
}
async function saveWeightedOverlay(){
  if(!woPreviewResults) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById("woSaveBtn");
  btn.disabled = true;
  try{
    for(const o of woPreviewResults){
      await callMethod(API+"upsert_feature", {
        geometry: JSON.stringify(o.geometry),
        title: "Susceptibility zone (score "+fmtNum(o.score,2)+")",
        source_module: "Map Viewer",
        properties: {weighted_score: o.score, source_layers: o.sources},
      });
    }
    toast(woPreviewResults.length+" susceptibility zone(s) saved.");
    await loadAll(document.getElementById("farmFilter").value || undefined);
  }catch(e){
    toast("Save failed: "+e.message, true);
  }finally{
    btn.disabled = false;
  }
}

      const isProp = e.target.value === "property";
      document.getElementById("woFixed"+which+"Field").style.display = isProp ? "none" : "";
      document.getElementById("woProp"+which+"Field").style.display = isProp ? "" : "none";
    });
  });
  document.getElementById("woRunBtn").addEventListener("click", runWeightedOverlay);
  document.getElementById("woSaveBtn").addEventListener("click", saveWeightedOverlay);

  document.getElementById("railToggleMobile").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
    document.getElementById("ssRail").classList.toggle("open");
  });
}
// Generic over however many tabs the dock has - the two built in (query,
// process) plus whatever plugins/addDockTab() have appended since boot, so
// a plugin's tab works identically to a native one with no special-casing.
function switchDockTab(tab){
  document.querySelectorAll(".float-tab").forEach(t=>t.classList.toggle("active", t.dataset.tab===tab));
  document.querySelectorAll(".dock-tab-content").forEach(el=>{
    el.style.display = el.dataset.tabContent===tab ? "block" : "none";
  });
  const activeTab = document.querySelector(`.float-tab[data-tab="${tab}"]`);
  if(activeTab) document.getElementById("dockTitle").textContent = activeTab.textContent;
}

// ─────────────────────────────  Plugin API  ─────────────────────────────
// Everything above this point is Map Viewer's own closed-over internals -
// a plugin loaded as a separate <script> afterward can't reach any of it
// directly. This is the one deliberate seam: a small, stable surface a
// plugin can build against (add a toolbar button, add a dock tab, read the
// selected feature, call any whitelisted backend method) without needing
// to know how the core is implemented, so the core is free to change
// without breaking plugins as long as this surface holds still.
const pluginRegistry = [];
let pluginsBooted = false; // true once the initial loadPlugins() pass has activated everything once

function addToolbarButton({id, icon, title, label, onClick}){
  if(id && document.getElementById(id)){
    console.warn("Toolbar button already exists, not adding a duplicate:", id);
    return document.getElementById(id);
  }
  const btn = document.createElement("button");
  btn.className = "btn btn-sm";
  if(id) btn.id = id;
  if(title) btn.title = title;
  btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid ${escHtml(icon||"fa-puzzle-piece")}"></i>${label?escHtml(label):""}`;
  document.querySelector(".ss-ribbon-r").appendChild(btn);
  if(onClick) btn.addEventListener("click", onClick);
  return btn;
}

let pluginTabDividerAdded = false;
function addDockTab({tab, label, render}){
  if(document.querySelector(`.float-tab[data-tab="${tab}"]`)){
    console.warn("Dock tab already exists:", tab);
    return;
  }
  // Visually separates native tools (Query/Geoprocessing/Layout) from
  // plugin-contributed tabs sharing the same dock - added once, before
  // the first plugin tab, not per-tab.
  if(!pluginTabDividerAdded){
    const divider = document.createElement("div");
    divider.className = "tab-divider";
    divider.title = "Plugin tabs";
    document.querySelector(".float-tabs").appendChild(divider);
    pluginTabDividerAdded = true;
  }
  const tabBtn = document.createElement("div");
  tabBtn.className = "float-tab";
  tabBtn.dataset.tab = tab;
  tabBtn.textContent = label;
  tabBtn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
    document.getElementById("dockTitle").textContent = label;
    switchDockTab(tab);
    openPanel("panelDock");
  });
  document.querySelector(".float-tabs").appendChild(tabBtn);

  const content = document.createElement("div");
  content.className = "float-body dock-tab-content";
  content.dataset.tabContent = tab;
  content.style.display = "none";
  content.id = "tab-"+tab;
  document.getElementById("panelDock").appendChild(content);
  if(render) render(content);
  return content;
}

function activatePlugin(plugin){
  try{ plugin.onActivate && plugin.onActivate(window.MapViewer); }
  catch(e){ console.error("Plugin failed to activate:", plugin && plugin.id, e); }
}

function loadScriptOnce(src){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject)=>{
    if(document.querySelector(`script[data-plugin-src="${src}"]`)) return resolve();
    const s = document.createElement("script");
    s.src = src;
    s.dataset.pluginSrc = src;
    s.onload = ()=>resolve();
    s.onerror = ()=>reject(new Error("Failed to load plugin script: "+src));
    document.body.appendChild(s);
  });
}

async function loadPlugins(){
  let plugins = [];
  try{
    plugins = await callMethod("upande_spatial.api.plugins.get_enabled_plugins", {});
  }catch(e){
    console.error("Could not load Map Viewer plugins:", e);
    return;
  }
  for(const p of plugins){
    try{ await loadScriptOnce(p.script_url); }
    catch(e){ console.error(e); }
  }
  pluginRegistry.forEach(activatePlugin);
  pluginsBooted = true; // registerPlugin() below now activates immediately for anything registered from here on
}

// The API surface itself - deliberately small and mostly thin wrappers
// around functions/state that already exist above, not new behaviour.
window.MapViewer = {
  registerPlugin(plugin){
    pluginRegistry.push(plugin);
    // During the normal boot sequence, loadPlugins() itself activates
    // every registered plugin once, after all plugin scripts have loaded -
    // activating here too would double-fire onActivate (this is exactly
    // what caused EPANET's toolbar button to appear twice). Only a plugin
    // registered some time AFTER that initial pass - none exist yet, but
    // a future "install a plugin into an already-open page" flow would -
    // needs this eager activation.
    if(pluginsBooted) activatePlugin(plugin);
  },
  getMap(){ return state.map; },
  getSelectedFeature(){ return state.selectedDetail; },
  callMethod,
  refreshLayers(){ return loadAll(document.getElementById("farmFilter").value || undefined); },
  addToolbarButton,
  addDockTab,
  openDock(tab){ switchDockTab(tab); openPanel("panelDock"); },
  toast, escHtml, fmtNum,
};

// ─────────────────────────────  Docked workspace (Golden Layout)  ─────────────────────────────
// Contents / Map / Properties as real dockable, resizable, floatable panels
// (drag a tab out and Golden Layout pops it into its own window) - this is
// the actual desktop-GIS-shell piece, not a cosmetic reskin. The three
// panels' content is the exact same DOM nodes that used to live in the
// fixed rail / canvas / floating detail popover - moved in wholesale so
// every listener already bound to them keeps working untouched.
let glInstance = null;
function setupGoldenLayout(onInitialised){
  const glConfig = {
    settings: {showPopoutIcon: true, showMaximiseIcon: true, showCloseIcon: false},
    dimensions: {borderWidth: 6, minItemWidth: 200, minItemHeight: 120},
    content: [{
      type: "row",
      content: [
        {type: "component", componentName: "contents", componentState: {}, title: "Contents", width: 18, isClosable: false},
        {type: "component", componentName: "mapArea", componentState: {}, title: "Map", isClosable: false},
        {type: "component", componentName: "properties", componentState: {}, title: "Properties", width: 22, isClosable: false},
      ],
    }],
  };

  glInstance = new GoldenLayout(glConfig, $("#glContainer"));

  glInstance.registerComponent("contents", function(container){
    const el = document.getElementById("ssRail");
    el.style.display = "flex";
    el.style.width = "100%";
    container.getElement().append(el);
  });
  glInstance.registerComponent("mapArea", function(container){
    const el = document.getElementById("mapAreaHolder");
    el.classList.add("gl-fill");
    el.style.display = "flex";
    container.getElement().append(el);
    // Leaflet doesn't notice its container resizing on its own - Golden
    // Layout's own resize event is what fires when a user drags a splitter
    // or pops/floats a panel, so that's the hook to keep the map in sync.
    container.on("resize", ()=>{ if(state.map) state.map.invalidateSize(); });
  });
  glInstance.registerComponent("properties", function(container){
    const el = document.getElementById("panelDetail");
    el.classList.add("gl-fill");
    el.style.display = "flex";
    container.getElement().append(el);
  });

  // GoldenLayout emits "initialised" SYNCHRONOUSLY from inside init() itself
  // - registering this listener has to happen before calling init(), not
  // after, or the event has already fired by the time anyone's listening
  // and nothing downstream (map, UI wiring, data load) ever runs at all.
  glInstance.on("initialised", onInitialised);
  glInstance.init();
  glInstance.updateSize();
  window.addEventListener("resize", ()=>{ if(glInstance) glInstance.updateSize(); });
}

// ─────────────────────────────  Boot  ─────────────────────────────
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(){
  setupGoldenLayout(async function(){
    initMap();
    wireUI();
    state.map.on("click", onMapClickForMeasure);
    await loadAll();
    await loadPlugins();
  });
});
})();
</script>
